ld.articleBody:
A Historic Pre-Release Milestone

Shah Rukh Khan's highly anticipated film King has achieved an unprecedented feat even before hitting theaters. The upcoming movie has secured a landmark overseas theatrical rights agreement, commanding a massive valuation that sets a brand new benchmark across the Indian film industry.

While southern Indian cinema has dominated domestic markets extensively in recent years, this massive international agreement proves that Shah Rukh Khan's star power abroad remains unmatched. The deal cements the project as one of the most commercially anticipated global releases of the year.

The Record-Breaking Phars Films Agreement

According to industry reports, Phars Films has acquired the international theatrical distribution rights for King at a staggering 175 crore rupees, which exceeds 18 million dollars. Previously, international rights for Shah Rukh Khan's ventures were predominantly handled by Yash Raj Films, which successfully distributed both Pathaan and Jawan in 2023.

Phars Films brings extensive global distribution experience to the table, having previously partnered with Yash Raj Films on multiple projects and independently handling the distribution of Prabhas's film Saaho. The 175 crore rupee figure represents a minimum guarantee amount, surpassing the 100 crore rupee threshold for the first time in Indian cinema history.

Financial Breakdown and Break-Even Targets

A minimum guarantee commitment of this magnitude highlights the immense confidence distributors hold in the theatrical potential of the feature. In international markets, distributors typically retain about 50 percent of the total box office collections, meaning King will need to generate substantial revenue to break even.

To clear its financial hurdles, the movie will need to pull in roughly 35 to 40 million dollars internationally, translating to approximately 350 to 375 crore rupees. For context, Shah Rukh Khan's previous blockbuster hits Pathaan and Jawan both crossed the 400 crore rupee mark in overseas territories.

Chasing International Benchmarks

Given the historic size of the minimum guarantee, turning a profit will require King to match or exceed the international milestones set by major hits like Dhurandhar 2 at 460 crore rupees or RRR at 430 crore rupees. These titles stand among the greatest international successes ever recorded by Indian cinema.

In addition to the international rights, separate reports indicate that Pen Marudhar has acquired the all-India distribution rights for 250 crore rupees. This continues a long-standing association with the actor's production house, following previous collaborations on Jawan, Dunki, Zero, Badla, and Ittefaq.

A High-Stakes Holiday Clash

Securing such high financial backing comes with heavy competition, as King is scheduled to premiere during the Christmas holiday season. The film faces a formidable box office showdown against massive Hollywood releases including Jumanji, Avengers: Doomsday, and Dune 3.

This high-profile scheduling creates one of the most intense competitive clashes in cinematic history. It offers the Bollywood superstar a major platform to demonstrate his enduring global dominance against top-tier international competition.

Star-Studded Cast and Crew

King features Shah Rukh Khan in the lead role and is directed by Siddharth Anand. This marks the second collaboration between the actor and director following their successful 2023 release Pathaan.

The supporting cast features Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan, Rani Mukerji, Jaideep Ahlawat, Raghav Juyal, and Saurabh Shukla. Notably, this project marks the first time Shah Rukh Khan shares the screen with his daughter Suhana Khan, who made her acting debut in 2023 with The Archies.

Release Details and News Overview

King is officially scheduled to open in cinemas worldwide on December 24, 2026.

Shah Rukh Khan's upcoming film King has set a historic benchmark by selling its overseas theatrical rights to Phars Films for 175 crore rupees ahead of its December 24 release. Backed by a high-stakes minimum guarantee, the action entertainer directed by Siddharth Anand must match legendary international earners like RRR and Dhurandhar 2 while navigating a massive holiday box office clash.

ld.articleBody:
The Passing of a Sci-Fi Legend

The entertainment industry is mourning the loss of legendary actor Patrick Stewart, who passed away on Wednesday at his home in Los Angeles. He was 86 years old at the time of his death.

His longtime spokesperson, Kelly Bush Novak, revealed that the star had been experiencing a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia. Family and friends surrounded him with live music, prayer, tears, and laughter during his final moments.

Defining Professor X on the Big Screen

Stewart anchored the original live-action X-Men franchise adapted from Marvel comic books for 20th Century Fox. He debuted as Professor Charles Xavier in the inaugural 2000 film, bringing immense gravitas and dignity to the mutant leader.

He reprised the iconic character across multiple sequels including X2: X-Men United, X-Men: The Last Stand, and X-Men: Days of Future Past, as well as making memorable appearances in the Wolverine standalone projects and the critically acclaimed Logan.

Tributes From Fellow Mutants and Co-Stars

Co-star Hugh Jackman, who portrayed Wolverine alongside Stewart, took to social media to express his heartbreak. Jackman noted that he lost a tremendous friend and mentor who taught him invaluable lessons about the craft of acting.

Rebecca Romijn, the original actress behind Mystique, shared her reflections on working with Stewart across two decades. She recalled his booming theatrical voice and wonderful sense of humor, celebrating his status as a classically trained Shakespearean great.

Memories From Star Trek and Television

Famke Janssen, who worked with Stewart on both Star Trek: The Next Generation and the X-Men franchise where she played Jean Grey, remembered him as an absolute legend. She highlighted her early experiences opposite him when she portrayed Kamala to his Captain Picard.

Kelsey Grammer also offered heartfelt recollections of collaborating with Stewart on the X-Men movies where Grammer played Beast. Grammer praised Stewart's unforgettable guest appearance on the hit sitcom Frasier during its eleventh season.

Marvel Studios and Kevin Feige Honor His Legacy

Marvel Studios head Kevin Feige shared his deep admiration for the actor, recalling the awe he felt seeing Stewart step onto the original X-Men set. Feige emphasized the actor's warm charm, quiet strength, and profound mentorship of younger talent.

Marvel Studios released an official statement recognizing the extraordinary grace and humanity Stewart brought to Professor Charles Xavier. The studio noted his lasting impact on generations of fans worldwide.

Final Cinematic Appearances

Beyond his decades of television and film history, Stewart was slated to appear in Marvel's upcoming project Avengers: Doomsday. His involvement in the feature will bring back several original Fox-era cast members.

His enduring presence in contemporary blockbusters cemented a career that bridged classic theatrical training with massive commercial success in science fiction cinema.

News Overview

Renowned actor Patrick Stewart passed away at the age of 86 in Los Angeles following a battle with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia. Co-stars, industry executives, and fans worldwide have shared heartfelt tributes celebrating his monumental contributions to the X-Men and Star Trek franchises.

Milestone Reached Before Theatrical Debut

Namit Malhotra's upcoming film Ramayana: Part One has officially crossed the fifty crore gross threshold in cumulative advance ticket sales across India. This major pre-release milestone arrives with three days left on the clock before the Nitesh Tiwari directorial officially arrives in theaters on November 5, 2026. Industry trackers noted that the robust pre-sales are being driven by a strong expansion in bookings stretching well beyond the opening day.

As additional cinema halls and screening slots come online, interest has heavily gravitated toward subsequent days like Saturday. The final phase of pre-sales is widely expected to set the stage for what could be a massive Diwali opening weekend for the big-budget epic.

Detailed Breakdown of Pre-Sale Numbers

According to the latest tracking data from early November 2026, the film generated approximately 49.75 crore gross including blocked seats. This figure accounts for nearly 11.87 lakh tracked tickets distributed across 37,685 shows spanning 1,738 cinemas nationwide. Factoring in additional Sunday bookings pushed the cumulative advance tally comfortably past the fifty crore mark.

A closer examination of the scheduled checkpoints reveals that Thursday, November 5 leads the charge with ₹25.94 crore from 6.05 lakh tickets. Friday, November 6 follows with ₹13.44 crore from 3.19 lakh tickets, while Saturday, November 7 has currently secured ₹10.28 crore from 2.62 lakh tickets.

Surging Momentum for Saturday Screenings

Saturday has quickly emerged as one of the most fascinating narratives in the current booking trend. Early in the week, the advance gross for Saturday stood at a modest 6.50 crore, but that figure climbed sharply to 10.25 crore by the afternoon checkpoint, representing a surge of roughly 56 percent.

This rapid upward trajectory is being supported by expanding show availability and fresh seat allocations across multiple regions. With Sunday's figures still awaiting separate reflection in these specific checkpoints, the movie retains substantial room to expand its overall weekend advance figures further.

Language Dominance and Regional Trends

In terms of linguistic contribution, the Hindi version continues to command the lion's share of the pre-sales, capturing approximately 84 percent of the total gross. The Kannada version stands second with roughly 9 percent, while the Telugu version accounts for 5 percent of the overall collections.

Regionally, Maharashtra leads the state-level figures with over 10.50 crore in gross collections. Delhi follows closely with 7.50 crore, and Karnataka records 7.30 crore, all figures inclusive of blocked seats. Meanwhile, Telangana is demonstrating notably stronger occupancy rates than several larger Hindi-speaking markets, whereas Tamil-language bookings remain comparatively subdued.

Impact of Premium Formats

Specialized premium formats are playing a vital role in elevating the value of Ramayana's advance bookings. Screenings across IMAX, 4DX, Dolby Cinema, ICE, and EPIQ have collectively pulled in approximately 9.50 crore gross including blocked seats.

Remarkably, these high-end formats account for about 19 percent of the total advance revenue despite representing only 2 percent of the tracked shows. While this highlights the immense revenue-generating capacity of premium screens, standard 2D and 3D formats will ultimately dictate the movie's broader, mass-market reach.

Pre-Release Foundation and Outlook

The achievement of crossing the fifty crore milestone before the final booking rush underscores a powerful pre-release foundation for the mythological project. Stakeholders are now watching closely to see how effectively this early momentum translates into continuous box office dominance during the festive window.

The final outcome will heavily depend on the ongoing pace of fresh ticket purchases, theater availability, and overall audience reception during the vital Diwali holidays, which will determine just how high the opening weekend figures can climb.

Global Premiere in Los Angeles

The much-anticipated mythological epic Ramayana: Rise of a Legend celebrated its grand worldwide debut in Los Angeles, drawing immense attention from fans and media alike. The main cast members gathered to launch the project internationally through an exclusive red carpet event.

Attendees and admirers caught the very first glimpses of the ambitious project during this major introductory phase held abroad.

Red Carpet Appearances by the Lead Stars

Ranbir Kapoor arrived at the venue dressed in a sparkling silver bandhgala while greeting supporters outside. Yash stepped onto the carpet alongside his wife Radhika Pandit, wearing a dark outfit paired with sunglasses and a detailed brooch, while Radhika wore a green and gold silk saree.

Sai Pallavi completed the main trio's look by opting for a red zardosi saree with detailed embroidery, keeping her styling simple and traditional.

Venue and Screening Details

The special 3D presentation took place at the David Geffen Theatre, situated within the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures. This initial viewing was strictly restricted to invited guests.

Social media feeds featured packed screening rooms filled with both domestic and international attendees waiting to witness the footage.

Notable Attendees and Interactions

Beyond the primary cast and crew, several notable figures from the entertainment industry joined the festivities. Jada Pinkett Smith, Rohini Iyer, Benji Kelly, and Gisella Marengo were among those spotted at the gathering.

Highlights from the red carpet included a warm embrace shared between Ranbir Kapoor and Yash in front of photographers.

Production Background and Creative Team

Nitesh Tiwari serves as the director of the film, with Namit Malhotra taking on production duties. The narrative adapts the classic ancient Indian epic for modern cinema audiences.

The central plot centers on the exile of Rama, the abduction of Sita by Ravana, and the subsequent confrontation representing the victory of righteousness over malevolence.

Cast and Release Schedule

The extensive star-studded cast features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Sunny Deol as Hanuman, and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. Additional supporting performers include Anupam Kher, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Arun Govil, Indira Krishnan, and Lara Dutta.

The theatrical rollout is scheduled globally for October 5, followed by paid preview screenings starting on November 4.

News Overview

The primary cast of Ramayana: Rise of a Legend attended an exclusive invite-only global premiere in Los Angeles. The event featured red carpet appearances by the lead actors alongside international celebrities prior to the film's upcoming theatrical release.

ld.articleBody:
The Inaugural Cut Week Arrives

Viewers are bracing for a massive shakeup on the popular reality singing competition as the series introduces its first-ever Cut Week. Bypassing traditional intermediate stages, this unique format serves as the sole bridge connecting the earlier battle rounds directly to upcoming live performances.

Under the new guidelines, coaches find themselves managing seven artists each. While two contestants on every team automatically secure their advancement to the live broadcasts, the remaining five must fiercely battle over a single open spot, ultimately narrowing the field down to the final twelve hopefuls.

Schedule and Time Slot Adjustments

Fans tuning in must make note of a permanent timing shift for the series. Moving forward, the program shifts to a Monday slot beginning at 9:00 p.m. Eastern Time.

This adjustment accommodates the scheduling returns of two network comedies, St. Denis Medical and The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins, which occupy the preceding hour from 8:00 to 9:00 p.m. ET.

Broadcast Details for Monday Night

The special episode, designated as Season 30, Episode 11 and titled Cut Week, is scheduled to broadcast on Monday, November 2. The extended broadcast runs from 9:00 to 11:00 p.m. ET.

Following this intense elimination event, the competition transitions entirely into weekly live shows leading directly up to the grand season finale.

Traditional Cable and Cord-Cutting Options

Traditional television viewers can catch the broadcast live using standard cable credentials through NBC or via the official network website and mobile application.

Audiences who have eliminated traditional cable subscriptions can utilize alternative live television streaming platforms. Services such as DIRECTV, fuboTV, Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV, and Sling TV offer access to the live NBC feed, with several providers offering introductory free trials for new sign-ups.

Streaming on Peacock

In a major first for the current season, episodes receive a simultaneous broadcast on Peacock, allowing fans to watch the event as it airs digitally.

Additionally, full episodes become available for next-day streaming on the platform. Subscribers can choose between the ad-supported Premium tier or the commercial-free Premium Plus option, with annual billing discounts also available.

Alternative Ways to Access Peacock

Viewers looking for trial access can subscribe to Peacock Premium Plus through Prime Video to utilize a seven-day promotional period not offered directly through the platform itself.

Another alternative involves utilizing Instacart+, which bundles a complimentary subscription to the streaming service as part of its membership perks.

News Overview

The Voice introduces its inaugural Cut Week with a special two-hour episode airing on Monday, November 2, from 9:00 to 11:00 p.m. ET on NBC due to a schedule shift for network comedies. Fans can watch the historic elimination round live on television, via live-streaming platforms, or stream the program on Peacock.

ld.articleBody:
The Grand Unveiling of the Eetha Trailer

Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations have officially launched the highly anticipated trailer for their upcoming cinematic project titled Eetha. The preview offers audiences an immediate glimpse into an epic musical drama that traces the remarkable trajectory of a true legend.

At the center of this grand production is actress Shraddha Kapoor, who takes on the titular role of Eetha Bai. The newly revealed footage showcases her transformation into an iconic figure of Lavani, setting the stage for a theatrical release scheduled for December 4, 2026.

Stepping Into the Vibrant World of Eetha Bai

The newly released trailer transports viewers directly into the rich and visually striking universe inhabited by Eetha Bai. It highlights a narrative where raw ambition routinely clashes with severe adversity, turning human passion into an engine of power.

Every single performance depicted in the preview emphasizes themes of deep courage and unwavering conviction. The footage relies heavily on evocative musical compositions, striking visual aesthetics, and intense emotional displays to build anticipation.

Celebrating an Extraordinary Artistic Legacy

The cinematic narrative draws profound inspiration from the real-life journey of a Lavani legend who systematically defied societal conventions. She fought against overwhelming odds to carve out a permanent place in history.

By focusing on her resilience, the film aims to celebrate the unyielding spirit of an artist whose impact spans across generations. The project positions itself as a grand spectacle specifically tailored for the big screen experience.

A Distinctive Role for Shraddha Kapoor

Taking on the character of Eetha Bai marks one of the most distinctive and demanding acting assignments of Shraddha Kapoor's career thus far. The actress anchors the sweeping saga with a commanding presence visible throughout the preview.

Her portrayal invites moviegoers to witness a deeply compelling story of triumph over obstacles, executed through a performance designed to leave a lasting impression on cinema audiences.

The Creative Minds Behind the Camera

The film brings together a dedicated crew committed to delivering a larger-than-life storytelling experience. Directorial duties are handled by Laxman Utekar, who also serves as a producer alongside Dinesh Vijan.

The backing of major banners like Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations underscores the considerable scale and ambition of this musical biographical drama.

Release Details and Anticipation

Fans eagerly awaiting the film's debut can mark their calendars for December 4, 2026, when Eetha officially arrives in cinemas. The combination of its lead star, musical elements, and historical inspiration has quickly made it a major talking point.

As promotional materials continue to roll out, the project stands out as a unique entry in contemporary Indian cinema, blending musical grandeur with biographical drama.

ld.articleBody:
A Surprising Streaming Phenomenon

The World War II survival thriller Lucky Strike has rapidly climbed to the top of streaming charts, securing the number one film position on Hulu. Following its arrival on the platform, the feature managed to capture a massive audience despite fierce competition from horror features and Halloween-themed programming.

This sudden surge in viewership marks a remarkable turnaround for the project. Although it struggled significantly during its theatrical release, home audiences have embraced the title, demonstrating that traditional war dramas still hold substantial appeal in the modern digital landscape.

Plot and Setting

ld.articleBody:
Los Angeles World Premiere and Review Embargo

The first wave of international reviews for the high-profile epic Ramayana has officially arrived following a grand world premiere in Los Angeles. The review embargo for the film lifted on a recent Friday night, allowing a select group of international publications to share their initial assessments.

The movie features a star-studded cast including Ranbir Kapoor and Yash. While anticipation for the project has been immense, the first batch of critiques provides a nuanced look at how the cinematic adaptation of the classic epic is being received abroad.

Praise for Visuals and Production Value

Despite mixed feelings regarding the plot, several critics heaped high praise on the technical execution and grand scale of Ramayana. Reviewers highlighted the ambitious production design and visual effects as major highlights of the cinematic experience.

Avi Offer of NYC Movie Guru commended the feature as a visually dazzling action adventure backed by strong set and costume design. Similarly, Screen Rant awarded the film a 7 out of 10, calling it an impressive achievement on a purely visual and technical level.

IndieWire and Other Critical Perspectives

IndieWire awarded the production a 'B', describing it as an epic that successfully achieves its goal of delivering the highest possible production value. However, the reviewer noted that the final product occasionally lacks a distinct voice to make it uniquely memorable.

Other publications were less forgiving of the storytelling choices. Some critics felt the heavy reliance on high-end production overshadowed the character depth, leaving certain elements of the narrative feeling mechanical rather than organic.

Criticism of Length and Stuffed Narrative

Even though the English version of Ramayana runs nearly half an hour shorter than the Indian cut, the two-and-a-half-hour runtime failed to satisfy several early reviewers. Complaints centered around a bloated and exhausting narrative structure.

Some international critics described the viewing experience as emotionally hollow and overly cluttered. One reviewer bluntly compared the theatrical format unfavorably against grand serialized television productions.

Comparisons to Television Formats

The sheer density of the mythological material prompted discussions on whether a traditional feature film format was the ideal medium. Reviewers suggested that the sprawling plotlines required significantly more room to breathe.

Next Best Picture remarked that the movie might have worked better as a television adaptation akin to Game of Thrones, allowing the narrative to flesh out its extensive cast and world fully instead of feeling overly stuffed.

Harsh Critiques and Technical Missteps

Among the tougher assessments, IGN handed out a lower score of 4 out of 10. The review pointed to clunky action sequences, subpar computer-generated imagery, and awkward artificial intelligence lip-syncing as drawbacks.

Furthermore, these critical reviews emphasized that this installment represents only the first part of a larger planned cinematic journey, leaving certain structural resolutions for future entries.

Cast, Crew, and Release Details

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The project is produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios alongside DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations.

The film is structured as a two-part release. The first part is slated to arrive globally on November 5, with paid previews in the United States set for November 4, while the second part is scheduled for a Diwali 2027 release. Sony Pictures handles international distribution outside India, and Dharma Productions distributes in the Hindi market.

International reviews for the Ranbir Kapoor and Yash-starrer Ramayana have emerged following its premiere in Los Angeles. While critics widely applauded the film's dazzling visuals and high production scale, they raised concerns about its exhausting and overstuffed narrative.

ld.articleBody:
Digital Announcement of the 26th IIFA Winners

The International Indian Film Academy published the complete winners list for its 26th edition through its official social media channels. Organizers chose to disclose the triumphant films, performers, and technical creators ahead of the physical celebrations.

This digital reveal granted cinema enthusiasts an early glimpse into which projects captured audience and jury favor throughout the entertainment calendar.

Dhurandhar Secures a Record-Breaking 12 Trophies

Aditya Dhar's espionage action feature emerged as the undisputed titan of the evening, securing a massive total of 12 awards spanning popular, creative, and technical domains.

The project triumphed in categories such as Best Film, Best Director for Aditya Dhar, and Best Original Story, reflecting its overarching dominance across the board.

Ranveer Singh and Aneet Padda Earn Top Acting Prizes

The leading acting accolades went to prominent stars for their acclaimed performances in major theatrical releases. Ranveer Singh secured the trophy for Best Actor in a Leading Role.

Meanwhile, Aneet Padda triumphed in the Best Actress category for her widely discussed work in a major romantic drama released earlier in the theatrical cycle.

Saiyaara Shines Bright Across Musical and Romantic Categories

Mohit Suri's directorial venture made waves by capturing multiple major music and performance honours. The romantic drama resonated deeply with audiences through its emotional core and commercial triumph.

Playback singers and lyricists associated with the project were duly recognized for crafting some of the most memorable tracks of the year.

Streaming Projects Lead the Digital Awards Segment

The digital categories celebrated outstanding work originating from various streaming platforms and web series formats. High-profile productions took home top honours for web series and digital feature films.

Creators and actors working within the digital ecosystem received recognition for expanding the scope of contemporary storytelling.

Upcoming Live Ceremony and Broadcast Details

While winners were unveiled online, the physical celebration is slated to take place at the Etihad Arena located on Yas Island in Abu Dhabi. The main gala and digital awards events will unfold across consecutive dates.

Global fans will be able to stream the main festivities live via YouTube, while regional television broadcasts will cater to audiences within India through official partnerships.

ld.articleBody:
Box Office Performance

The adult comedy Wicker is currently outperforming many previous releases from Black Bear that featured prominent Hollywood stars. Industry tracking indicates that the film is on track to surpass the domestic haul of Jason Statham's Shelter, establishing itself as the studio's biggest hit at the North American box office in the year 2026.

Due to its strong commercial traction, the feature has also secured a significant expansion in screen time across North America.

Crossing the Ten Million Mark

Headlined by Olivia Colman, the movie has successfully crossed the $10 million threshold at the North American box office, reaching a total of $10.6 million according to Box Office Mojo data.

The theatrical footprint for the feature expanded substantially, growing from 1,471 theaters to 2,374 locations across the region.

Second Friday Record

On its second Friday, the film brought in $1.4 million at the North American box office. This figure marked a modest decline of just 39.6% compared to its opening Friday earnings.

Industry records confirm this performance stands as the biggest second Friday ever recorded in the history of the Black Bear studio.

Weekend Projections and Shelter Comparison

Current industry estimates project that the feature will earn between $3.5 million and $4.5 million over the three-day weekend in North American cinemas.

For context, Shelter was released earlier in the year and finished its domestic run with a gross of $12.8 million. The current trajectory places Wicker firmly on course to exceed that number.

Studio Profitability

This milestone cements Wicker as Black Bear's biggest domestic success and represents the studio's first major hit at the North American box office. Data regarding the film's overseas collections remains unavailable.

The studio acquired the North American rights for the film at a modest cost of $2.5 million, rendering the venture highly profitable.

Plot and Premise

Directed by Alex Huston Fischer and Eleanor Wilson, the story follows an ostracized fisherwoman who hires a local basketmaker to weave a husband for her.

When her wicker creation turns out to be unexpectedly extraordinary, his sudden arrival generates jealousy and turmoil that threatens the peace of their quiet village.

Cast and Release Details

The movie features a notable ensemble cast including Olivia Colman, Alexander Skarsgård, Elizabeth Debicki, Marli Siu, Nabhaan Rizwan, Richard E. Grant, and Peter Dinklage in key roles.

Wicker was officially released to audiences on October 23.

news:18643y9.k: Ramayana Part One, Ranbir Kapoor Yash Ramayana, Ramayana Mumbai premiere, Ramayana advance booking, Mahi Pillai Ramayana: Part One, Ramayana: Part One, Mahi Pillai, Ranbir Kapoor Ramayana: Part One, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Upcoming Mumbai Screening

Ramayana: Part One is scheduled for a special event in Mumbai before its official theatrical debut in India. The upcoming gathering serves as a dedicated screening for the project's cast and crew members along with invited industry guests.

A separate media screening has also been scheduled to follow the initial event, providing journalists and reviewers an opportunity to watch the production ahead of its wide theatrical launch.

Venue and Timeline Details

The Mumbai premiere is set to take place at Lower Parel's IMAX on November 3, with the media screening arranged for November 4. Organizers had initially considered the Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre for the gathering before ultimately deciding on the IMAX venue.

The theatrical release across India is officially scheduled for November 5, bringing the project to local audiences following weeks of promotional activity and international showcases.

International Screenings and Reactions

Prior to the Mumbai schedule, the film held its Los Angeles premiere on October 27, where audience reactions were noted as mixed. Following that event, a screening took place in London on November 1.

The London presentation specifically welcomed critics and members of the BAFTA jury to view the Hindi version of the production before its broader commercial rollout.

Advance Booking Numbers

As the theatrical launch approaches, advance ticket sales have opened across multiple formats throughout the country. Reports indicate that the production accumulated a considerable advance booking collection of Rs 45 crore in India by the early hours of November 2.

These early sales figures reflect strong pre-release interest from moviegoers eager to secure their seats for opening day across various participating theatres.

Cast and Crew Members

The feature is directed by Nitesh Tiwari and features a prominent ensemble cast. Ranbir Kapoor takes on the role of Lord Ram, Sai Pallavi stars as Sita, and Yash portrays Ravana.

Additional key cast members include Ravi Dubey as Lakshman, Sunny Deol as Hanuman, Arun Govil as King Dashrath, Lara Dutta as Kaikeyi, and several others spanning a large supporting roster.

Distribution and Global Reach

Dharma Productions is managing the distribution responsibilities for the theatrical run within India. Meanwhile, Sony Pictures is handling the international distribution strategy, which includes plans for the China market.

These partnerships aim to ensure a wide global footprint as the multi-language production reaches audiences across different international territories.

News Overview

Ramayana: Part One is scheduled for a special Mumbai premiere at Lower Parel's IMAX on November 3 ahead of its November 5 India release. The production has already held international screenings in Los Angeles and London while accumulating Rs 45 crore in Indian advance bookings by November 2.

news:1893n5f.d: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has crossed a major milestone in North America, becoming the first Kollywood film to gross $7.5 million and achieving profitable…
news:1893n5f.k: Jailer 2 North America box office, Rajinikanth Jailer 2 collection, Jailer 2 Kollywood record, Jailer 2 profit break-even, Rajinikanth Jailer 2, Jailer 2, Rajinikanth, Nelson Dilipkumar Jailer 2, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Milestone Achievement in North America

The action-comedy thriller starring Rajinikanth has reached a monumental milestone in North America. The film has officially become the first Tamil cinema release to cross the $7.5 million threshold in the region.

Continuing its strong theatrical run, the project has established itself as the highest-grossing Kollywood feature of all time in this overseas market.

Day 16 Collections and Growth

On its sixteenth day, which marked the third Friday of its run, the movie collected $90K. This figure represented a substantial 200 percent jump compared to the previous day's collection of $30K.

The cumulative gross in the territory now stands at a massive $7.59 million, translating to roughly 72.04 crore in Indian rupees.

Week-Wise Breakdown

During its opening week covering the first eight days, the magnum opus accumulated $6.04 million. The second week added another $1.453 million to the tally.

With the recent single-day additions, the total gross has safely pushed past expectations, and trade experts note that the feature is presently on course to target the $8 million milestone.

Crossing the Break-Even Mark

To achieve commercial safety in North America, the production needed a total of $6.5 million, which equals about 61.69 crore. Having surpassed that target within 16 days, the venture has officially entered profitable territory.

The current profit margin sits at $1.09 million, or approximately 10.34 crore, with further earnings anticipated before upcoming theatrical competition arrives.

Future Prospects and Competition

Despite having already rewritten regional box office records, the feature still has room to expand its totals. However, future growth will be monitored closely as Ramayana gears up for a major release on November 5.

Globally, anticipation remains high as well, with talks of potential records being broken during the festive Diwali season.

Cast, Crew and Production Details

Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and backed by producer Kalanithi Maran through Sun Pictures, the film features a star-studded ensemble. Alongside Rajinikanth, prominent roles are played by SJ Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Ramya Krishnan, and Vidya Balan.

The theatrical rollout began on October 15, 2026, following a reported production budget of 350 crore.

News Overview

Jailer 2 has made history as the first Kollywood film to gross $7.5 million at the North American box office after 16 days in release. The Rajinikanth starrer has successfully cleared its break-even target to yield a profit in the territory.

news:195lnut.k: It Welcome to Derry, Stephen King streaming show, It Welcome to Derry Season 2, Bill Skarsgard Pennywise, Stephen King It: Welcome to Derry, It: Welcome to Derry, Stephen King, Andy Muschietti It: Welcome to Derry, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
A Surprising Global Streaming Resurgence

Nearly a year after concluding its gripping freshman season, the horror television prequel inspired by Stephen King's literary universe has re-emerged as a major force on digital platforms. Despite skepticism that often accompanies franchise expansions, this chilling series has captured audience attention worldwide without simply recycling past scares.

The show currently occupies the number six spot on both United States and international streaming charts. This sudden spike in viewership follows a recent season renewal announcement and a special Halloween episode rollout.

Setting the Stage in 1962 Derry

Titled It: Welcome to Derry, the program serves as an official precursor to the theatrical film adaptations released in 2017 and 2019, which draw from King's extensive 1986 novel. The narrative transports audiences back to 1962 as bizarre tragedies begin plaguing the local township.

A group of children starts digging into the unexplained deaths while newcomers Major Leroy Hanlon, his wife Charlotte, and their son Will discover a malevolent entity residing within the municipal drainage system.

Creative Leadership and Literary Ties

The project was brought to life by filmmaker Andy Muschietti, producer Barbara Muschietti, and writer Jason Fuchs, utilizing background elements and interludes found within the original source material. While the terrifying villain Pennywise serves as a direct link, the television narrative also incorporates broader connections to the author's wider fictional universe.

Notably, chef Dick Halloran from The Shining plays a significant part in the plot, showcasing his psychic abilities and tying different corners of King's literary creations together.

Critical Reception and Fan Response

Upon its initial premiere, the project drew praise from critics who lauded the strong ensemble cast and Bill Skarsgård's chilling return as the iconic shape-shifting clown. Reviewers also commended the uncompromising and graphic tone maintained throughout the episodes.

On Rotten Tomatoes, the show currently maintains an 81 percent critical approval rating alongside an 82 percent audience score, reflecting sustained enthusiasm from horror enthusiasts.

Looking Ahead to Season 2

Following months of anticipation after its initial run, Warner Bros. officially granted the program a second season renewal in August 2026. While an exact premiere date remains unannounced, showrunners have revealed ambitious plans for the upcoming episodes.

The narrative will reportedly shift even further back in time to 1935 during the Great Depression. The plot will focus on the violent massacre of the Bradley Gang, a notorious group of bank robbers who meet an unimaginably terrifying fate when passing through Derry.

Production Team Updates

Brad Caleb Kane is slated to return as the sole showrunner for the upcoming sophomore chapter. Additionally, creative expansion is underway with the inclusion of Ethan King, the author's grandson, joining the writing staff for the new season.

With deep roots in the original mythology and fresh historical settings on the horizon, the series continues to expand the boundaries of televised horror.

News Overview

The television prequel It: Welcome to Derry has climbed into the top ten streaming charts globally one year after its initial release. Backed by a recent season renewal and a special Halloween episode, the horror series will explore 1935 during its upcoming second season under returning showrunner Brad Caleb Kane.

news:196c562.k: You Maniac Episode 10, William Est You Maniac finale, You Maniac Thai BL release time, Dean and Moth You Maniac, William Jakrapatr You Maniac, You Maniac, William Jakrapatr, Est Supha You Maniac, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
The Conclusion of You Maniac

The Thai BL series You Maniac reaches its final chapter today, October 31, 2026. Fans of the romantic drama are preparing to say goodbye to the central couple as the story wraps up its broadcast run.

The series has maintained significant attention throughout its run, driven by the onscreen partnership of its lead actors and the emotional resonance of the storyline.

Evolution of Dean and Moth

The narrative originally began as a lighthearted fake-dating arrangement between a playboy and his love interest. Over time, the dynamic evolved into an authentic emotional bond dealing with healing, vulnerability, and past trauma.

In the preceding episode, Moth provided crucial support to Dean following the loss of his father, setting the stage for their relationship to move past its initial contractual pretense.

Love Versus Personal Ambition

As the finale arrives, the couple faces a major reality check involving their individual futures. Moth reveals his long-held dream of applying for a scholarship in New York, admitting he would regret missing the chance.

Dean reacts emotionally to the news, asking Moth to stay instead of relocating and questioning whether he holds a genuine place in his partner's heart.

Resolutions and Source Material

The central conflict of the finale centers on whether Moth will choose his romance or his career aspirations. Followers of the original novel have some insight into the trajectory, anticipating a happy conclusion for the pair.

The journey of Dean and Moth has generated widespread social media discussion, with viewers sharing their emotional reactions online as the final broadcast approaches.

Broadcast Timings and Platforms

The final episode airs on GMMTV at 8:30 PM Thailand time, corresponding to 7:00 PM IST. International viewers outside of Thailand can access the episode through streaming platforms like iQIYI and Viki.

Indian audiences can tune in to the Thai BL drama via Viki, while alternative viewing options on Dailymotion are expected to become available shortly after the original broadcast.

Offline Viewing Guide

Subscribers of Viki can utilize the application's download feature to watch the finale offline. Users simply need to open the app, search for the official series page, and select the final chapter.

By tapping the download icon next to the episode, viewers can save the media directly to their device for later playback through the application's downloads section.

The Thai BL series You Maniac concludes its run on October 31, 2026, with the release of its final episode. The finale addresses the ultimate fate of Dean and Moth as they weigh their romantic relationship against an opportunity in New York.

news:196dfm.k: Udta Teer box office, Ayushmann Khurrana Udta Teer, Sara Ali Khan Udta Teer, Udta Teer collection, Udta Teer, Ayushmann Khurrana, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Entering the Second Week with Steady Numbers

The theatrical run of Udta Teer has transitioned into its second week with commendable stability. Headlined by Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan, the spy comedy picture managed to pull audiences into cinema halls even after completing its first full week on the silver screen.

Trade trackers observed that the drop from the initial Friday was remarkably contained, pointing to healthy word-of-mouth backing the feature. This retention allows the production to secure a strong footing as it faces the typical weekday and weekend shifts.

Breakdown of the Second Friday Earnings

On its second Friday, the feature brought in an estimated collection of Rs 2.75 crore at the domestic ticket windows. This figure reflects only a minor decline compared to its opening day figures, signaling that weekday exhaustion has not heavily disrupted its run.

With this latest addition, the cumulative nett collections in India have scaled up to Rs 32.75 crore after eight days of exhibition. Analysts attribute this resilient performance to steady footfall across key urban centers.

Comparing the Opening Week Trajectory

Looking back at its initial seven-day journey, the project experienced an encouraging opening weekend before settling into a predictable weekday routine. It opened to Rs 3.75 crore, surged to Rs 7.25 crore on Saturday, and peaked on Sunday with Rs 8.00 crore.

As the week progressed, the collections stabilized around Rs 3.00 crore on Monday and Tuesday, before tapering down to Rs 2.50 crore on Wednesday and Thursday respectively, setting up a solid foundation for the second week.

Cast, Crew, and Creative Direction

The picture brings together a fresh lead pairing of Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan, who shoulder the narrative responsibilities of this lighthearted espionage venture. Their on-screen chemistry forms the core appeal for moviegoers seeking theatrical entertainment.

news:196xm51.d: Ae Dil Hai Mushkil: As the romantic drama marks its 10th anniversary, director Karan Johar reflects on the power of one-sided love, embraces the film's flaws…
news:196xm51.k: Karan Johar, Ranbir Kapoor, Anushka Sharma, Ae Dil Hai Mushkil, Channa Mereya, Karan Johar Ae Dil Hai Mushkil, Ranbir Kapoor Ae Dil Hai Mushkil, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Marking a Decade of Cinema

The romantic drama directed by filmmaker Karan Johar completed ten years on Wednesday. To celebrate the milestone, the director penned a heartfelt social media post reflecting on the journey of the movie.

Released a decade ago, the feature continues to evoke strong nostalgia among audiences who remember its grand scale and emotional resonance.

Exploring the Power of One-Sided Love

At the core of the narrative is the theme of unrequited affection, which the director described as deeply personal. He noted that the project emerged from his own pursuits of longing and vulnerability.

According to the filmmaker, loving someone does not require sympathy or remorse, nor does it demand reciprocation. Instead, he argued that genuine affection is an act of total selflessness.

Embracing Imperfections and Polarised Reviews

Upon its initial release, the feature encountered mixed reactions, particularly regarding the developments in its third act. Critics and viewers pointed out various narrative flaws.

Despite the varied reception, the director maintained that he would present the story in the exact same manner today. He emphasized that artistic conviction must ultimately override conventional logic.

A Star-Studded Ensemble Cast

The motion picture brought together a prominent lead lineup featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Anushka Sharma, and Aishwarya Rai Bachchan. Their performances brought the complex emotional dynamics to life.

In addition to the primary trio, the project featured notable appearances by other stars, including Fawad Khan, Shah Rukh Khan, Alia Bhatt, and Lisa Haydon.

Creating the Ideal 'Vatavaran' on Set

The director made sure to express gratitude toward the entire working crew and principal actors for establishing a wonderful working environment. He credited them with generating the perfect 'vatavaran' during production.

Their collaboration allowed the director to execute his cinematic vision authentically, resulting in powerful interpretations of the characters.

An Enduring Musical Legacy

Beyond its storytelling, the project left behind a massively popular musical footprint. Compositions such as the title track, 'Channa Mereya', 'Bulleya', 'The Breakup Song', and 'Cutipie' remain widely celebrated.

A decade later, these tracks continue to resonate with fans just as strongly as they did during the initial premiere.

News Overview

Filmmaker Karan Johar celebrated the 10th anniversary of his directorial venture 'Ae Dil Hai Mushkil' on Wednesday by sharing reflections on unrequited love and the film's personal significance to him. He thanked the cast, including Ranbir Kapoor, Anushka Sharma, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, and guest stars like Shah Rukh Khan and Fawad Khan, for bringing his vision to life despite the polarised reviews the project originally received.

news:19klbo7.d: Rajinikanth's action-drama Jailer 2 experienced a steep decline in ticket sales on its 20th day in theatres, bringing in its lowest single-day collection yet…
news:19klbo7.k: Jailer 2 box office, Rajinikanth Jailer 2 collection, Jailer 2 day 20 collection, Nelson Dilipkumar Jailer 2, Rajinikanth Jailer 2, Jailer 2, Rajinikanth, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Steep Decline on the Twentieth Day

Rajinikanth's action entertainer Jailer 2 faced a severe setback at the box office on its twentieth day in cinemas. According to tracking data from Sacnilk, the action drama witnessed a drastic drop in ticket sales, bringing in a mere Rs 17 lakh net domestically on its third Tuesday.

This figure stands in stark contrast to the earnings recorded just a day prior. The substantial reduction marks the lowest single-day collection for the feature since it first premiered on the big screen.

Comparison With Previous Earnings

The latest single-day collection represents a massive decrease of roughly 95 percent when compared to the seventeenth day, when the film had successfully brought in Rs 3.40 crore net.

This sharp contraction arrives after an exceptionally lucrative initial run. During its opening eight days in theatres, the highly anticipated sequel amassed a massive Rs 334.35 crore net, followed by an additional Rs 98.55 crore during its second week.

Overall India Net Collection

Despite the sudden slowdown in daily ticket sales, the cumulative performance of the feature remains remarkably strong. With the latest figures factored into the ledger, the total domestic net business for the project has reached Rs 459.87 crore.

As the movie inches closer to crossing the Rs 460 crore threshold in India, the upcoming days will be critical in dictating how much further the theatrical run can stretch.

Release Details and Production Team

Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the movie opened in cinemas on October 15, 2026. The big-budget action venture is produced by Kalanithi Maran under the banner of Sun Pictures.

The creative team behind the production includes composer Anirudh Ravichander, who provided the musical score, and cinematographer Vijay Kartik Kannan, who handled the camera work for the sequel.

Plot and Character Arc

In this sequel, veteran star Rajinikanth reprises his role as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, a retired jailer who finds himself unwillingly pulled back into a perilous world of crime. Hoping to lead a peaceful existence with his family, his plans are disrupted by an international idol-smuggling syndicate.

To dismantle the criminal network and safeguard his loved ones, the protagonist goes undercover, assuming the identity of a driver to infiltrate the gang's inner operations.

Star-Studded Cast and Cameos

The film features an extensive ensemble cast alongside the lead actor. Performers including SJ Suryah, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Mithun Chakraborty, Ramya Krishnan, Vidya Balan, and Yogi Babu appear in pivotal roles throughout the runtime.

Additionally, the project includes special appearances by several notable stars, such as Mohanlal, Shiva Rajkumar, Hrithik Roshan, Jackie Shroff, and Vijay Sethupathi.

External Box Office Competition

The recent cooling off in ticket sales coincides with the arrival of November and the festive Diwali week. Additional pressure is expected as major competing titles prepare to enter the theatrical landscape.

Notably, the feature faces upcoming competition from Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi's high-profile project Ramayana: Rise of a Legend, which arrives in theatres on November 5.

News Overview

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 experienced a sharp 95 percent drop in collections on its 20th day, earning Rs 17 lakh net on its third Tuesday to record its lowest single-day haul. Despite this steep slowdown, the Nelson Dilipkumar directorial has reached an overall India net collection of Rs 459.87 crore as it faces growing competition during the Diwali week.

news:19nd32c.k: Jonathan Rhys Meyers Pretty Kill Machine, Matthew Wilder Pretty Kill Machine, Pretty Kill Machine vampire movie, Quantify AFM Pretty Kill Machine, Pretty Kill Machine, Jonathan Rhys Meyers, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Return to the Vampire Genre

Jonathan Rhys Meyers is officially heading back into the world of bloodsuckers and eternal darkness. Approximately a decade after previously portraying Dracula for television networks NBC and Sky, the accomplished star has signed on for a brand new cinematic venture titled Pretty Kill Machine. This upcoming film marks a notable return to the supernatural horror-romance genre that he previously helped bring to life on the small screen.

The announcement has generated considerable early interest among fans of gothic storytelling and vampire lore. Rhys Meyers brings a distinct presence to dark material, making his casting a major focal point for the production as it prepares to enter the wider film market.

Plot and Setting Details

The narrative of Pretty Kill Machine unfolds primarily in and around Joshua Tree, California. The story centers on a supernatural entity named Vee, who has walked the earth since before recorded history. While she is technically a vampire in the traditional sense, she prefers to view herself simply as a day drinker, drifting between an elegant hotel bar and a mirrored, glass-walled lair situated deep in the desert.

Vee sustains herself by feeding on blood and, more dangerously, on human souls. However, her centuries-long existence of solitary wandering is suddenly thrown into deep crisis when she experiences genuine romantic love for the very first time. This unprecedented emotional development threatens to bring her eternal reign to an abrupt end for good.

Character and Casting Dynamics

While Vee navigates her startling new emotional awakening, Jonathan Rhys Meyers will portray the human man who captures her attention and ultimately wins her heart. The dynamic between the ancient supernatural being and her mortal romantic interest forms the emotional core of the narrative.

Known for his prominent television roles in hit series such as The Tudors and Vikings, Rhys Meyers is well-equipped to handle the intense dramatic requirements of a dark, high-stakes romance set against an isolated desert backdrop.

Creative Leadership and Direction

The creative vision for Pretty Kill Machine is being shaped by writer and director Matthew Wilder, who is handling both the screenplay adaptation and the direction of the film. Wilder previously directed Your Name Here, bringing his distinct artistic perspective to this new genre project.

Production duties are being spearheaded by David Hillary, known for Bill Ted Face the Music, alongside Yariv Lerner. Lerner also serves as the Chief Executive Officer of Nu Boyana Studios, ensuring strong logistical backing for the independent feature.

Global Sales and Market Launch

Global sales and distribution for the movie are being handled by Quantify, a newly formed international sales and distribution company. Quantify is a collaborative venture established by Nu Boyana Studios, Dark Matter Studios, Government Island, and Film Forge Media.

The company has scheduled the official worldwide sales launch for the upcoming AFM market. Executives at the firm are confident that the unique premise and strong leading man will attract substantial interest from international buyers.

Industry Expectations and Outlook

Industry figures have expressed optimism regarding how the global market will receive the project. Yariv Lerner of Quantify noted that Wilder has constructed a genuinely sensuous and dangerous cinematic world, anchored securely by Rhys Meyers at the center.

With a blend of supernatural lore, desert atmosphere, and high-stakes romance, the film aims to stand out among independent offerings at the market, positioning itself as a major title to watch as pre-sales progress.

Jonathan Rhys Meyers is returning to the vampire genre to star in the romantic feature Pretty Kill Machine, directed by Matthew Wilder and sales-launched by Quantify. The story follows an ancient supernatural entity in Joshua Tree who faces a crisis after falling in love with a mortal man played by Rhys Meyers.

news:19oobjn.d: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has officially overtaken SS Rajamouli's Baahubali 2 in Kerala by reaching ₹72.85 crore gross by Day 13.

ld.articleBody:
Breaking a Nine-Year Record in Kerala

A historic theatrical benchmark in Kerala has finally been shattered after standing firm for nearly a decade. Rajinikanth's latest action spectacle has officially surpassed the long-standing box office record held by SS Rajamouli's epic.

Achieving this milestone in just thirteen days, the Nelson Dilipkumar directorial has claimed the title of the highest-grossing non-Malayalam film in the state's cinematic history.

How Baahubali 2 Maintained Its Throne

Back in 2017, Baahubali 2 captivated audiences nationwide due to massive curiosity surrounding the central narrative question and director SS Rajamouli's grand vision. It quickly outpaced previous contenders like Vikram's I.

The film went on to run in hundreds of theatres over several weeks, establishing a high lifetime collection benchmark that remained untouched by subsequent pan-India releases for nine years.

Fall of Previous Pan-India Blockbusters

Over the nine-year period, several high-profile films featuring major stars such as Prabhas, Yash, Vijay, and Allu Arjun arrived in theatres. Big titles like KGF Chapter 2 and Leo generated massive hype but fell short of the ultimate target.

Market dynamics in Kerala require sustained audience interest beyond initial fan bases, making long-term dominance difficult for outside-language releases competing against a robust local Malayalam industry.

The Unique Strengths of Jailer 2

Jailer 2 benefited heavily from the established popularity of its predecessor, which introduced Rajinikanth's Muthuvel Pandian character to regional viewers. The combination of signature action, humour, and music worked strongly in its favor.

Furthermore, Mohanlal's special association with the franchise through his character Mathew helped bridge the gap with local Malayalam audiences, driving heavy initial interest.

Early Momentum and Screen Presence

The theatrical run was supported by robust pre-release demand, generating over ₹1.61 crore in Kerala advance bookings within the first hour alone.

A wide distribution footprint featuring a release across approximately 800 screens provided the film with substantial early access to eager moviegoers.

News Overview

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 collected ₹72.85 crore gross in Kerala by Day 13, breaking Baahubali 2's nine-year record to become the highest-grossing non-Malayalam film in the state.

The film achieved this milestone thanks to strong early advance bookings, a wide screen count, and the combined appeal of its star cast.

Jailer 2 Kerala Box Office Day 13 Creates History at ₹72.85 Cr, Breaks Baahubali 2's 9-Year Record

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has officially overtaken SS Rajamouli's Baahubali 2 in Kerala by reaching ₹72.85 crore gross by Day 13.

Published 28 October 2026

Breaking a Nine-Year Record in Kerala

A historic theatrical benchmark in Kerala has finally been shattered after standing firm for nearly a decade. Rajinikanth's latest action spectacle has officially surpassed the long-standing box office record held by SS Rajamouli's epic.

Achieving this milestone in just thirteen days, the Nelson Dilipkumar directorial has claimed the title of the highest-grossing non-Malayalam film in the state's cinematic history.

How Baahubali 2 Maintained Its Throne

Back in 2017, Baahubali 2 captivated audiences nationwide due to massive curiosity surrounding the central narrative question and director SS Rajamouli's grand vision. It quickly outpaced previous contenders like Vikram's I.

The film went on to run in hundreds of theatres over several weeks, establishing a high lifetime collection benchmark that remained untouched by subsequent pan-India releases for nine years.

Fall of Previous Pan-India Blockbusters

Over the nine-year period, several high-profile films featuring major stars such as Prabhas, Yash, Vijay, and Allu Arjun arrived in theatres. Big titles like KGF Chapter 2 and Leo generated massive hype but fell short of the ultimate target.

Market dynamics in Kerala require sustained audience interest beyond initial fan bases, making long-term dominance difficult for outside-language releases competing against a robust local Malayalam industry.

The Unique Strengths of Jailer 2

Jailer 2 benefited heavily from the established popularity of its predecessor, which introduced Rajinikanth's Muthuvel Pandian character to regional viewers. The combination of signature action, humour, and music worked strongly in its favor.

Furthermore, Mohanlal's special association with the franchise through his character Mathew helped bridge the gap with local Malayalam audiences, driving heavy initial interest.

Early Momentum and Screen Presence

The theatrical run was supported by robust pre-release demand, generating over ₹1.61 crore in Kerala advance bookings within the first hour alone.

A wide distribution footprint featuring a release across approximately 800 screens provided the film with substantial early access to eager moviegoers.

News Overview

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 collected ₹72.85 crore gross in Kerala by Day 13, breaking Baahubali 2's nine-year record to become the highest-grossing non-Malayalam film in the state.

The film achieved this milestone thanks to strong early advance bookings, a wide screen count, and the combined appeal of its star cast.

Key facts

  • Jailer 2 collected ₹72.85 crore gross in Kerala by Day 13.
  • Baahubali 2 held a lifetime collection of approximately ₹72.25 crore in Kerala.
  • The record had stood for nine years since 2017.
  • Jailer 2 generated more than ₹1.61 crore in Kerala advance bookings within the first hour.
  • The film released across approximately 800 screens.

news:19rqpux.d: The Batman Part II: Production on the highly anticipated superhero sequel experienced an unexpected interruption when a cast member was struck by the iconic…

ld.articleBody:
The Production Mishap

Production for the upcoming superhero sequel encountered a major disruption when an accident on set left a cast member hospitalized. According to insiders familiar with the project, the individual was accidentally struck by the signature vehicle while cameras were rolling on a high-octane action sequence.

The unexpected collision immediately brought operations to a standstill as safety personnel rushed to assist the injured performer. Witnesses noted that the dangerous nature of modern blockbuster filmmaking brings inherent hazards, serving as a stark reminder of the physical risks actors and crew members face daily.

Recovery and Resumption of Work

Fortunately, the severity of the incident was mitigated by prompt medical intervention. After receiving initial care at a nearby medical facility, the injured individual was discharged and is currently continuing their recuperation from home.

With the safety and well-being of the team addressed, studio executives confirmed that production has officially recommenced. Filming is currently underway at Leavesden Studios located in Hertfordshire, bringing the crew back to familiar stages.

Returning Cast and Core Characters

The continuation of shooting brings back the central star of the franchise, with Robert Pattinson reprising his role as Bruce Wayne. The billionaire vigilante remains the cornerstone of the cinematic universe as he continues his crusade against crime in Gotham City.

Beyond the leading star, the sprawling ensemble features several notable returning actors and new additions. The roster includes talents such as Colin Farrell, Andy Serkis, Jeffrey Wright, and Scarlett Johansson, all contributing to the expansive narrative.

Behind-the-Camera Transitions

The production journey has navigated various structural changes alongside its physical challenges. Earlier reports indicated that original director Matt Reeves needed to step away from the helm due to personal matters.

In response to the leadership shift, the production brought in accomplished filmmaker Steven Soderbergh, widely recognized for his work on Ocean's Eleven, to take over directorial duties and steer the project forward.

Fan Theories and Narrative Clues

Enthusiasts of the franchise have spent months analyzing minor hints and promotional clues regarding potential antagonists. Speculation intensified following social media posts featuring theatrical props and masked figures resembling classic comic book villains.

Discussion boards have buzzed with theories surrounding characters like Two-Face and Victor Zsasz, alongside cryptic set markers such as an 'OWL 3' label hinting at the notorious secret society known as the Court of Owls.

Release Timeline and Expectations

Despite the temporary setback caused by the recent stunt accident and previous behind-the-scenes adjustments, studio scheduling remains intact. The feature is currently slated to debut in cinemas in February 2028.

Anticipation continues to build across global fan communities as details slowly emerge about the direction of the narrative, promising another dark and immersive chapter in the ongoing saga.

News Overview

Production on The Batman Part II experienced a temporary halt after a cast member was struck by the Batmobile during a stunt sequence and subsequently hospitalized to recover at home. Filming has since resumed at Leavesden Studios in Hertfordshire under the reported direction of Steven Soderbergh, while the release remains scheduled for February 2028.

news:19xe7td.d: Chris Pratt is heading back to streaming with a brand new military-themed project, stepping into the role of a Navy SEAL for the upcoming Apple TV adaptation.
news:19xe7td.k: Way of the Warrior Kid, Chris Pratt Apple TV movie, Way of the Warrior Kid release date, Jocko Willink Way of the Warrior Kid, Chris Pratt Mercy, Mercy, Chris Pratt, Rebecca Ferguson Mercy, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
A Return to Streaming

Renowned Hollywood actor Chris Pratt is officially gearing up for his next major streaming appearance, which is scheduled to arrive in just one month. Known globally for anchoring massive blockbuster cinematic universes like Marvel and Jurassic World, the actor frequently balances high-profile theatrical releases with direct-to-consumer streaming projects. His latest venture shifts him away from the silver screen and brings him back into familiar tactical territory.

The upcoming project follows a string of diverse releases for Pratt over recent months. Earlier in the year, he paired up with actress Rebecca Ferguson for the science fiction artificial intelligence thriller Mercy. Although that particular film encountered financial hurdles at the box office against its substantial production budget, it managed to find immense popularity with home audiences, surging to become one of the most-streamed titles of the year on Prime Video.

Finding Box Office Redemption

While some of his streaming ventures cater to audiences at home, Pratt also secured major theatrical success recently. He found swift box office redemption when he took on a prominent role in The Super Mario Galaxy Movie. That animated feature dominated ticket sales globally, officially becoming the very first film of the year to cross the coveted one-billion-dollar milestone worldwide.

Despite his massive animated hits and sci-fi excursions, militaristic and tactical roles remain a defining staple of Pratt's career. His most notable episodic television endeavor has been The Terminal List. While that gritty series commanded immense fan attention, waiting for subsequent installments has proven to be a lengthy process for viewers compared to other streaming action dramas on the market.

Stepping Into Apple TV's New Military Project

In a matter of weeks, Pratt will transition to a brand new platform for a military-centric narrative that shares thematic DNA with his previous gritty work, though infused with significantly more emotional heart. The project in question is Way of the Warrior Kid, an original movie slated for release on Apple TV. Anticipation for the feature has steadily mounted among action enthusiasts.

The streaming platform kicked off the promotional campaign by dropping the official first trailer for Way of the Warrior Kid earlier in the week. The promotional footage immediately showcased Pratt looking completely at home while wearing the uniform of a Navy SEAL, signaling a tone that blends high-stakes tactical discipline with a grounded, character-driven narrative arc.

Cast and Creative Team Behind the Adaptation

Beyond the headline-grabbing presence of Chris Pratt, the film boasts a compelling supporting cast. Way of the Warrior Kid features performances from notable actors Linda Cardellini and Jude Hill. The collaborative effort brings together a diverse group of talent to anchor the emotional core of the streaming feature.

The narrative is directly adapted from the popular published novel of the same name. Notably, the author of the original source material, Jocko Willink, crosses over into the cinematic adaptation by taking on an acting role in the film as Coach Adam, bringing authentic military perspective directly to the screen.

Behind the Scenes Leadership

The creative forces shaping the production behind the camera include a seasoned pair of filmmakers. The screenplay for the adaptation was drafted by writer Will Staples, who translated the source material into a narrative fit for a feature-length streaming release.

Directing duties for Way of the Warrior Kid were handled by filmmaker McG. Together, the creative team aims to deliver a family-friendly yet inspiring military drama that highlights resilience, mentorship, and personal growth under pressure.

Plot and Premise

The central storyline of the film revolves around a young, self-doubting protagonist who struggles with being bullied at school. Feeling isolated and lacking confidence, the kid's life begins to turn around when his uncle, a battle-tested Navy SEAL, comes to stay at his home for the summer.

Through disciplined mentorship, guidance, and tough love from his uncle, the youngster gradually discovers his inner strength. The narrative tracks his journey toward finding genuine courage and finally learning how to stand up for himself against adversity.

Release Details and Availability

Fans eager to watch Chris Pratt's latest military drama won't have to wait much longer. Way of the Warrior Kid is officially scheduled to premiere on Apple TV.

The movie becomes available to stream starting on November 25. Viewers and enthusiasts can tune in directly to the platform to catch the release and follow related coverage.

News Overview

Chris Pratt is returning to streaming services with his upcoming Apple TV military drama Way of the Warrior Kid, scheduled for release on November 25. The film, directed by McG and adapted from the novel by Jocko Willink, also features Linda Cardellini and Jude Hill in its cast. Pratt plays a Navy SEAL uncle who helps his bullied nephew find the courage to stand up for himself.

ld.articleBody:
The Official Trailer Drop

The entertainment industry has received a fresh surge of excitement with the release of the official trailer for the upcoming action drama titled Pratap. The promotional video sets an intense tone, introducing viewers to a turbulent narrative filled with high-stakes action and unexpected plot developments. At the center of the story is a police officer whose existence undergoes a drastic upheaval when his fortunes reverse entirely, placing him on the wrong side of the law.

Rather than sticking to a linear storytelling format, the newly revealed trailer moves back and forth between the protagonist's past and present. It highlights his former life as a law enforcer while teasing his current reality as an inmate. Despite showing glimpses of his difficult journey, the promotional material successfully maintains the mystery surrounding the exact reasons behind his imprisonment, leaving audiences curious about the catalysts for his downfall.

Character Dynamics and Cast Details

Versatile actor Amit Sadh leads the project, stepping into the shoes of the titular character Pratap. Described as a decorated encounter specialist, Pratap has dedicated a significant portion of his career to putting dangerous criminals behind bars. However, the narrative flips this premise on its head by forcing the lawman to navigate the harsh realities of being a prisoner himself, creating a profound internal conflict as he fights for his own survival.

Alongside Amit Sadh, the film features Esha Deol in a prominent capacity, supported by a wider ensemble cast. Both lead actors have expressed enthusiasm for the project, noting that the narrative steers clear of traditional tropes and offers deeply layered character arcs that challenge the conventional boundaries of standard cop dramas.

Cast Insights and Perspectives

Speaking about his involvement in the project, Amit Sadh discussed the unconventional nature of his role. He pointed out that Pratap avoids being a routine police story, drawing him in through the complex trajectory of a man who spent his entire life enforcing regulations only to experience life from the opposite perspective. The actor highlighted the multitude of emotions and internal contradictions embedded within the character, which provided a compelling challenge for his performance.

Similarly, co-star Esha Deol shared her thoughts regarding what attracted her to the venture. She emphasized that the plot holds much more depth than a straightforward narrative suggests. According to her, the story unfolds with multiple layers that prompt viewers to reevaluate the characters and their evolving circumstances as the plot progresses, while also praising her collaboration with the cast and crew.

Release Timeline and Promotional Rollout

Anticipation for the feature has been steadily building through various promotional milestones. Prior to the arrival of the trailer, the production team unveiled the official movie poster, offering fans an initial aesthetic look at the project. These marketing steps are designed to build momentum ahead of the film's theatrical debut.

Marking your calendars, Pratap is officially scheduled to land in cinema halls on November 20, 2026. As the release date approaches, cinephiles and fans of action-heavy thrillers await further promotional content to learn more about the dark turns awaiting the protagonist.

News Overview

The official trailer for the action drama Pratap has been released, starring Amit Sadh as an encounter specialist turned inmate and Esha Deol in a prominent role. The film uses a non-linear narrative to explore the protagonist's past and present imprisonment while maintaining the mystery behind his downfall. Pratap is scheduled to release in theaters on November 20, 2026.

ld.articleBody:
The Birthday Celebration

Shah Rukh Khan marked his 61st birthday on November 2, prompting an overwhelming wave of affectionate messages from both dedicated admirers and industry colleagues across social media. Among the countless greetings shared online, a particularly warm message arrived from his longtime friend and fellow Bollywood superstar, Salman Khan.

Taking to Instagram Stories, Salman extended his heartfelt greetings by wishing the King of Romance eternal youth and success. The public exchange between the two iconic actors quickly captured widespread attention and charmed internet users globally.

A Witty Comedic Reply

Demonstrating his trademark humor, Shah Rukh responded to Salman's warm message with a cheeky remark regarding physical fitness. The playful banter between the two veterans highlighted their longstanding camaraderie and effortless rapport.

Fans readily shared the lighthearted interaction across various platforms, turning the quick exchange into a major talking point of the birthday celebrations.

Decades of Friendship

The bond shared by Shah Rukh and Salman spans multiple decades within the Hindi film industry. Their enduring friendship has previously seen them share screen space in notable cinematic titles such as Karan Arjun and Kuch Kuch Hota Hai.

Beyond their memorable joint appearances, the two superstars have consistently demonstrated mutual support for each other's professional endeavors, solidifying their status as one of Bollywood's most celebrated peer relationships.

Mannat Fan Gathering

Continuing a beloved annual tradition, Shah Rukh made dedicated time to connect personally with the massive crowds gathered outside his residence, Mannat. Dressed casually in a white t-shirt and trousers, the actor stepped out to acknowledge the sea of supporters.

The assembly erupted into loud cheers as the superstar appeared on the balcony, eventually treating the crowd to his iconic, signature pose with open arms.

Project Context: King

The birthday festivities also drew heightened focus toward King, Shah Rukh's anticipated upcoming feature directed by Siddharth Anand. The high-profile action thriller boasts a massive star-studded cast featuring Deepika Padukone, Suhana Khan, Abhishek Bachchan, Rani Mukerji, Anil Kapoor, Jackie Shroff, Jaideep Ahlawat, Arshad Warsi, Raghav Juyal, and Abhay Verma.

Backed jointly by Red Chillies Entertainment and Marflix Pictures, the film is slated for a theatrical release on December 24, 2026.

Industry Wishes

In addition to Salman's message, numerous other prominent figures from the film fraternity showered the birthday boy with love and admiration. Directors and actors alike posted celebratory notes recognizing the superstar's milestone year.

These widespread industry tributes underscored Shah Rukh's enduring influence and stature within contemporary Indian cinema.

Shah Rukh Khan celebrated his 61st birthday on November 2, receiving a warm public greeting from longtime friend Salman Khan that the actor humorously acknowledged. The superstar also maintained his tradition of greeting fans outside Mannat while anticipation continued to build for his upcoming action thriller King, releasing on December 24, 2026.
