ld.articleBody:
The Festive Season Kicks Off

Bollywood's highly anticipated Diwali party calendar is officially underway, drawing immense interest from fans and media alike. The celebratory season was set into motion by actor Ayushmann Khurrana and his wife, Tahira Kashyap, who hosted an exclusive festive bash at their Mumbai residence on Friday. The star-studded opening event welcomed several prominent figures from the film industry, including prominent filmmaker Karan Johar, actors Sara Ali Khan and Twinkle Khanna, alongside producer Bhushan Kumar, marking a glamorous start to weeks of festivities.

Traditions and New Realities

These annual celebrations are a staple of the Hindi film industry calendar, offering a rare glimpse into the social lives of its biggest stars. While fans eagerly track every guest list and outfit, the initial gathering at the Khurrana residence signals the beginning of a packed schedule spanning late October and November. However, the atmosphere surrounding these high-profile events is noticeably different this year, with organizers and attendees navigating new security realities that have cast a shadow of caution over the usual revelry.

Heightened Security and Media Restrictions

Behind the glamour and flashing lights, a sense of caution prevails across the entertainment district. Following a recent firing incident that targeted actor Tiger Shroff, security protocols have been drastically tightened for major industry gatherings. According to veteran paparazzi figure Pallav Paliwal, media personnel were not invited to cover the opening party at the Khurrana household. This exclusion points to a broader shift in how celebrity events are managing crowd control and media access during a tense period.

Verification and Access Controls

The security tightening extends beyond private residences into major industry events. Paliwal noted that for a recent prominent awards ceremony, media professionals were strictly required to present their Aadhaar cards for entry verification. Industry insiders expect similar stringent identification checks and restricted media zones to be enforced across upcoming Diwali parties. Despite these tight controls, photographers have managed to map out a tentative calendar of the major bashes scheduled for the weeks ahead.

Late October Celebrations

The lineup of upcoming celebrations features some of the industry's most influential hosts and producers. On October 30, producer Anand Pandit is scheduled to host a grand bash, with anticipated attendees including actors Kriti Sanon and Sidharth Malhotra. Additionally, Kriti Sanon is reportedly planning to host her own celebration, though specific dates have yet to be officially confirmed. These gatherings promise to keep the social circuit buzzing as the festival of lights approaches its peak.

November Party Lineup

Moving into November, the calendar grows even busier. Producer Ramesh Taurani is set to host his annual party on November 2, though industry regular Salman Khan may reportedly miss the event this time around. Following closely on November 3, hosts Akshay Kumar and Twinkle Khanna will welcome guests to their celebration. The calendar also highlights high-profile events hosted by designer Manish Malhotra on November 5, which traditionally draws a massive turnout of top-tier celebrities, and producer Ektaa R Kapoor on November 7.

Notable Absences

While several major bashes are locked into the schedule, not every celebrity host is returning to the party circuit this year. Actor Dia Mirza Rekhi, who welcomed an intimate gathering of friends and colleagues for the festivities last year, has decided not to host a gathering this time around. Similarly, filmmaker Nikkhil Advani, who threw a widely discussed Diwali bash in 2025, has confirmed that he will skipping hosting duties for the current festive season.

A Monitored Season

These selective cancellations highlight a more subdued approach by certain members of the fraternity, balancing personal comfort and safety against the traditional obligation of hosting large-scale industry parties. As the remaining hosts finalize their guest lists and security arrangements, the 2026 Bollywood Diwali season is shaping up to be a heavily monitored and tightly managed affair compared to the uninhibited celebrations of previous years.

Despite some cancellations and tighter access controls, several major bashes remain scheduled through late October and November.

ld.articleBody:
International Advance Booking Surge

The highly anticipated cinematic adaptation Ramayana: Part One is hurtling toward a massive global debut as international advance reservations pick up significant steam. With the official theatrical launch scheduled for November 5, 2026, ticket sales across various international territories have demonstrated robust momentum.

Trade analysts and industry trackers have noted that overseas pre-sales figures have climbed steadily, crossing critical financial thresholds well ahead of the first public screenings. The intense demand underscores the widespread appeal of the mythological project directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra.

North American Milestone and US Pre-Sales

A major highlight of the pre-release phase is the performance in North America, where premiere ticket sales have crossed the $1 million mark. Paid preview screenings set for November 4 have driven a substantial portion of this early success across multiple locations and showtimes.

In the United States alone, the upcoming paid premieres have accumulated nearly $945,000 from tens of thousands of tickets sold across hundreds of locations. When combined with figures from Canada, the total North American premiere advance has cleared approximately $1.065 million.

Comparison With Previous Blockbusters

The early ticketing data places Ramayana ahead of several historic Indian cinematic benchmarks in terms of advance ticket counts. By selling over 43,000 tickets for its US preview screenings, the film has moved past estimated figures previously set by major titles such as Baahubali 2.

While regional variations show that states like California and Illinois are performing exceptionally well, other pockets demonstrate contrasting patterns. Despite tracking slightly behind certain recent blockbusters like Dhurandhar 2 in specific regions, the overall ticket sales outpace historical markers for other major releases like Jawan and RRR at similar points in their advance cycles.

Projected Opening Weekend Targets

Industry forecasts now point toward a lucrative international opening weekend exceeding $20 million. If secondary international markets and remaining territories outperform expectations, trade experts suggest the global debut could stretch toward $25 million.

Reaching the upper tier of these projections would place Ramayana ahead of the overseas opening records established by major titles from previous years, setting a high standard for contemporary Indian cinema releases in global markets.

The Middle East Factor and Global Distribution

A key element that could influence the final opening weekend tally is the potential rollout in the Middle East. Because advance ticketing in that specific region has not yet commenced, those potential revenues remain absent from current pre-sale milestones.

Additionally, international distribution managed by Sony Pictures is expected to facilitate wider access across non-traditional overseas territories, potentially helping the mythological epic reach audiences far beyond the traditional diaspora.

Key Challenges and Final Pre-Release Phase

Despite the impressive early numbers, the film faces practical considerations including lengthy runtimes and fierce competition for premium cinema formats and screens. The ultimate success of the opening weekend will rely heavily on sustained audience turnout after the initial fan-driven screenings conclude.

As the industry counts down to the November 4 paid previews, the final stretch of advance reservations will determine whether the feature can fully capitalize on its monumental global hype and secure a historic box office debut.

ld.articleBody:
The Return of the Time-Looping Thriller

Prime Video has officially unveiled the first look images for the third and final season of its supernatural thriller, The Devil's Hour. The series, which revolves around complex time loops and mind-bending mysteries, is scheduled to make its long-awaited return next month.

Fans have had to wait a couple of years for the continuation of the story, but the streaming platform has finally locked in the premiere date. The upcoming run will consist of five episodes, serving as the conclusive chapter for the acclaimed production.

Release Date and Streaming Details

The third instalment of The Devil's Hour will officially land on Prime Video on Friday 4 December 2026. Alongside the date confirmation, the streamer provided exclusive preview images to build anticipation among viewers.

Subscribers and newcomers will be able to access the final five-part run directly through the platform. The series continues to be one of the notable high-profile drama offerings on the streaming service.

First Look and Character Appearances

The newly released promotional photos feature the main cast members reprising their familiar roles. Jessica Raine returns as Lucy Chambers, while Peter Capaldi steps back into the shoes of the serial killer Gideon Shepherd.

In addition to the leads, Nikesh Patel is back as DI Ravi Dhillon. The preview images portray the characters looking tense and searching for answers, with both Lucy and Gideon seen wielding firearms and preparing for dangerous confrontations.

Expanding Ensemble Cast

Beyond the primary trio, the final season brings back several other notable performers from earlier runs. Viewers can expect appearances from Phil Dunster, Meera Syal, and Saffron Hocking.

This diverse supporting cast adds further depth to the supernatural narrative. Their return ensures continuity as the series weaves together its intricate web of timelines and unresolved conflicts.

Plot Premise and Narrative Direction

The official synopsis describes life in the series as a scratched record, looping over and over again without most people remembering their past iterations. However, Lucy Chambers has woken up and retains memories of her past life as a police detective who failed to stop a series of terrorist acts.

Now born again as neither a mother nor a police officer, Lucy is haunted by her past and turns to her former foe, Gideon. Together, the unlikely allies must track down a dangerous child-killer who has eluded them across multiple lifetimes.

Cliffhanger Resolution and Planned Trilogy

The second season concluded on a dramatic cliffhanger involving Gideon shooting Lucy in an attempt to trigger a reset and stop their mutual enemy. Meanwhile, Isaac called out to his mother upon hearing a familiar voice.

Star Jessica Raine previously mentioned that the production was always mapped out as a three-part story. This final run fulfills that original vision, bringing the overarching narrative structure to a planned and deliberate conclusion.

ld.articleBody:
The Impending Departure From Netflix

Subscribers in North America face a limited window to stream Jake Gyllenhaal's acclaimed feature Nightcrawler. The psychological thriller is officially scheduled to leave Netflix, with October 31 serving as the final day subscribers can watch it on the platform before its removal on November 1.

At present, no new streaming home has been announced for the title following its departure from Netflix. While viewers will still retain the option to purchase or rent the film digitally, anyone hoping to catch it via a subscription streaming service will need to act quickly.

An Iconic Performance by Jake Gyllenhaal

Released in 2014, the film stands as a defining entry in Jake Gyllenhaal's career, showcasing his talent for inhabiting complex and morally gray characters. In this 117-minute R-rated picture, the actor portrays Louis Bloom, an ambitious and unsettling criminal who stumbles into the ruthless world of crime journalism.

Gyllenhaal commands the screen with an unwavering intensity, crafting a protagonist who is simultaneously charming and deeply disturbing. Supported by a talented cast that includes Rene Russo, Bill Paxton, and Riz Ahmed, Gyllenhaal delivers a standout turn that many critics and fans still regard as his finest cinematic work.

A Sharp Indictment of the Modern Media

Beyond its tense atmosphere and psychological depth, the film offers a pointed commentary on contemporary media landscapes. The narrative serves as a stark critique of sensationalism in local news, exploring how extreme headlines and shocking imagery are leveraged to capture viewer attention.

Director Dan Gilroy designed the project to challenge viewers, pointing an accusing finger not just at news stations, but at the public consuming the broadcasts. In a 2014 interview, Gilroy noted that the narrative intended to implicate everyday viewers as active participants in the cycle of sensationalized media.

By consuming these broadcasts like fast food, audiences continually fuel the demand for graphic and sensationalized stories. This deeper thematic layer elevates the production beyond a standard thriller, securing its enduring critical acclaim.

The combination of sharp social commentary and a chilling lead performance has allowed the movie to maintain an exceptional reputation over the years. It currently holds a near-perfect 95 percent score on Rotten Tomatoes, reflecting its lasting impact on audiences and critics alike.

Despite notable award season snubs upon its initial theatrical run, the picture has cemented its status as a modern masterpiece in the thriller genre. Its exploration of ambition, media ethics, and societal complicity remains just as relevant today.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction To The Viral Sensation

Social media users have discovered an unexpected internet personality who bears a striking resemblance to a beloved Hollywood actor. Shri Swami Shashwat Acharya Ji Maharaj, a nineteen-year-old spiritual speaker based in Uttar Pradesh, has captured widespread attention online.

Rather than focusing solely on his traditional duties, internet users have fixated on his facial features and curly hair, which bear a remarkable likeness to a major Netflix television star.

The Stranger Things Connection

Online observers quickly pointed out that the young religious figure looks intensely like Finn Wolfhard, the actor famous for portraying Mike Wheeler in the hit sci-fi series Stranger Things.

This accidental doppelganger phenomenon has triggered a wave of side-by-side photo comparisons, lighthearted jokes, and various pop-culture references across multiple social platforms.

Background And Spiritual Duties

Born on August 5, 2007, Shri Shashwat Acharya serves as a Peethadhishwar at Shri Dham Goda Vihar Mandir located in Vrindavan. He is known for delivering Bhagwat Katha discourses centered around the teachings of Lord Krishna.

Remarkably, records indicate that he began reciting the Srimad Bhagavatam when he was only four years old, establishing a deep root in devotional traditions long before his sudden internet fame.

Nicknames And Internet Culture

As his videos circulated widely, internet users assigned him playful monikers such as 'Gen Z Baba' and 'Pookie Baba'. Comment sections quickly filled up with compliments and humorous remarks about finding a desi version of the Hawkins character.

This blend of modern internet culture and traditional religious discourse created a peculiar intersection where pop-culture fandom meets spiritual storytelling.

Impact On Audience Reach

While digital fame can often prove fleeting, the viral resemblance has successfully introduced the young speaker to a much broader demographic that might not otherwise have encountered his religious talks.

The crossover between global streaming fandoms and Vrindavan devotional traditions highlights how modern social media algorithms can elevate unexpected individuals into overnight sensations.

ld.articleBody:
Production Progress on the Animated Project

The upcoming animated adaptation of the popular title has advanced considerably since its initial unveiling. According to producer Sean McLoughlin, the project is moving through the pipeline at a much faster pace than observed earlier in the year.

Key creative roles have been filled to guide the production forward. Although specific names remain unannounced, a writer and a director are officially onboard to shape the narrative.

Mapping Out the Gothic Narrative

The story for the upcoming film is currently being developed to fit within the distinct gothic atmosphere established by FromSoftware. Creators have dedicated time to plotting out narrative beats and ensuring the direction respects the source material.

With key story milestones mapped out, the team feels confident about the current trajectory. Future announcements are anticipated to share minor teases regarding the plot and introduce the talent leading the adaptation.

Producer Passion and Fan Reactions

The producer, widely recognized online as Jacksepticeye, has previously expressed a deep personal connection to the franchise. Having documented a strong affinity for FromSoftware titles, he emphasized that protecting the integrity of the intellectual property remains a top priority.

Despite personal dedication and enthusiasm for the project, initial public reception encountered considerable pushback. Reports indicate that a vast majority of early responses to the adaptation announcement expressed heavy skepticism regarding the creative direction.

Addressing Quality and Creative Control

In response to community concerns, the production team has maintained that the IP is being handled with great care. Assurances were given that the final product would align with standards worthy of the original game's legacy.

The creative team insists that safeguards are in place to prevent the project from steering away from the core elements that fans cherish about the universe.

Contrast with the Gaming Front

While the cinematic adaptation sees steady movement, the video game front has remained largely stagnant for enthusiasts. Players continue to wait for updates, a modernization patch, or a sequel that has yet to materialize.

The lack of official attention toward the original interactive title on gaming platforms makes the development of the animated feature a rare source of active news for followers of the franchise.

News Overview

The Bloodborne animated film project is advancing steadily with a mystery writer and director now attached to map out the narrative. Despite facing initial skepticism from a large portion of the fanbase, the producer has assured supporters that the adaptation is in dedicated hands while the game itself sees no active updates.

news:1dhukox.k: Girish Johar, Soumyabrata Gupta, e-Cinepramaan, Girish Johar e-Cinepramaan, Soumyabrata Gupta e-Cinepramaan, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Security Scare at Film Board

The Central Board of Film Certification has encountered a severe data security scare after confidential materials tied to upwards of 500 cinematic titles were allegedly compromised. The exposed data reportedly remained accessible through digital archiving platforms for a period spanning multiple days before the security lapse was finally detected and brought to light.

Industry Anxiety

While initial assessments indicate that the actual media files and final film reels were not directly leaked, the situation has ignited intense industry-wide anxiety. Filmmakers, production banners, and various stakeholders are questioning the efficacy of existing security frameworks designed to protect proprietary information submitted during mandatory official compliance processes.

Exposed Scripts and Plot Points

Among the sensitive records allegedly exposed through the system are unreleased film scripts, detailed synopses, and pivotal plot points. For creators of upcoming features, the premature disclosure of narrative structures, character arcs, and unexpected twists poses a direct threat to carefully planned promotional rollouts and audience engagement strategies prior to theatrical or streaming debuts.

Censor Cut Orders

Additionally, the vulnerability compromised official records concerning censor cut orders and modifications mandated during the evaluation process. These files typically detail editorial changes and creative choices that production teams intend to keep under wraps until official public clearances are finalised, leaving creators with little recourse to manage the narrative.

Business and Commercial Vulnerabilities

Beyond creative storylines and editorial notes, the security lapse reportedly extended to private distribution agreements and intricate licensing fee details. These documents encompass sensitive commercial information for both domestic and international projects, including revenue-sharing models, intellectual property clauses, and binding contractual terms established between studios and distribution partners.

Risk of Disrupting Negotiations

The public exposure of such proprietary business data risks disrupting active negotiations and exposing confidential financial arrangements within the broader entertainment sector. Industry participants have voiced alarm over how commercially sensitive documentation of this magnitude could remain accessible through online archiving platforms without immediate detection.

Industry Reactions and Official Response

The revelation prompted swift reactions from prominent industry figures, including producer and market expert Girish Johar. Taking to social media via X, formerly Twitter, Johar publicly noted that documents ranging from scripts to distribution pacts had been exposed, confirming that the regulatory body had initiated an internal investigation and security audit to determine the scope of the failure.

The incident centers around the e-Cinepramaan portal, the dedicated online interface utilised by production houses to navigate the mandatory certification procedures. Because applicants are required to upload comprehensive project details and sensitive collateral to the platform, the breach has cast a harsh spotlight on the digital safety protocols guarding state-managed entertainment databases.

News Overview

A reported security breach on the Central Board of Film Certification portal left confidential scripts, cut orders, and distribution agreements for more than 500 films accessible on digital archiving platforms. Industry figures noted the incident, prompting the regulatory body to launch an internal investigation and security audit.

ld.articleBody:
The Unveiling of Super Mario Adventure

A brand new fan-made project titled Super Mario Adventure has recently captured the attention of the gaming community following the release of its debut promotional video. Shared online by a user named Reitcent over on Twitter/X, the footage showcases a classic 3D platformer experience designed specifically for the GameCube era.

The ambitious undertaking is being developed by a group known as Team Elements. Utilizing the Better Sunshine Engine, the creators have managed to build this title directly within the framework of Super Mario Sunshine, resulting in a visually nostalgic project that immediately resonates with retro enthusiasts.

A Nod to GameCube Era Aesthetics

The newly revealed footage presents quintessential platforming elements that feel right at home with early 2000s gaming sensibilities. Fans reviewing the promotional material have noted how successfully the developers have captured the distinct visual textures and unique aesthetic style of that specific hardware generation.

Rather than simply skinning an existing title, the project operates as an original 3D platformer concept. It effectively explores what an alternate timeline might have looked like if the GameCube had received a different core entry in the legendary franchise during its active lifespan.

Community Excitement and Early Reactions

Following the trailer's premiere on YouTube, enthusiastic viewers flooded the comments section to share their praise and anticipation for the eventual release. Many expressed deep admiration for the uncanny recreation of vintage video game styling, highlighting the appeal of the era's characteristic texture work.

Other community members discussed how refreshing it is to see creative interpretations of the classic formula, with several noting that the project sparks curiosity about what could have been. The positive reception underscores the enduring passion surrounding retro Nintendo hardware and its modding communities.

Development Status and Release Timeline

As of the current writing, Team Elements has not yet provided a definitive release date for the project. Because fan-driven passion projects are built without financial remuneration, the development team is taking a measured approach, indicating that the game will simply launch whenever it is fully ready.

The lack of a strict schedule is widely accepted by the community, who understand the voluntary and time-intensive nature of such fan-made endeavors. Consequently, supporters are content to monitor updates patiently as development continues behind the scenes.

Broader Context Within the Franchise

This fan-made creation arrives at a time when the broader gaming community continues to await official news regarding the next mainline entry in the series. Nintendo has kept quiet about its next flagship 3D Mario installment, leaving a significant gap since the launch of the critically acclaimed Odyssey in 2017.

While ardent fans frequently indulge in retro titles and community-driven modifications to fill the void, ongoing rumors suggest that 2027 might finally bring official announcements concerning the future of the beloved platforming franchise.

News Overview

Team Elements has revealed a trailer for Super Mario Adventure, an original 3D platformer built inside Super Mario Sunshine using the Better Sunshine Engine. While no official release date has been shared for the passion project, it has already drawn widespread praise from fans awaiting the next evolution of the classic franchise.

Directing the Next Nightmare

Horror enthusiast circles have a new reason to celebrate as filmmaker David Bruckner has officially committed to direct Smile 3 for Paramount. Following the success of the previous entries, the studio is expanding its terror-filled universe with a brand-new creative voice at the helm.

Bruckner brings substantial genre pedigree to the project. He previously directed the 2022 Hellraiser reboot for Hulu, alongside acclaimed atmospheric horror features such as The Night House and The Ritual.

Behind the Creative Handover

Parker Finn, who created, wrote, and directed the first two Smile films, is stepping back from the director's chair but remains deeply involved in the franchise. Finn developed and pitched the narrative framework for this upcoming third entry.

While Bruckner takes over directorial duties, Finn will actively guide the project as a producer. Additionally, Jonathan Fass has boarded the upcoming sequel to serve as executive producer.

The Writing Team and Vision

The script for Smile 3 is being written by Nick Antosca. The creative team aims to maintain the psychological tension that defined the earlier cinematic chapters.

Finn previously expressed his desire for future iterations of the property to expand significantly in scale. However, he also emphasized that the storytelling must preserve its intimate, character-driven impact on a human level.

Bruckner's Busy Slate

In addition to taking on Smile 3, David Bruckner has several other prominent projects in various stages of development. He is attached to direct Universal Pictures' adaptation of Marcus Kliewer's book The Caretaker, starring Sydney Sweeney.

Furthermore, Bruckner is lined up to helm the horror film Mice for A24 and is actively writing and developing a remake of the classic creature feature The Blob.

Parker Finn's Studio Deal

Parker Finn's ongoing collaboration with Paramount Pictures stems from a first-look deal he signed with the studio back in 2023. This partnership continues to yield major opportunities for the filmmaker.

Alongside his production duties on Smile 3, Finn is directing Paramount's upcoming remake of Possession, which features a starring cast that includes Callum Turner and Margaret Qualley.

Franchise Legacy and Success

The Smile franchise holds a formidable record at the box office. The original 2022 movie emerged as the top-grossing original horror film of that year.

Collectively, the property has proven to be a massive financial success for the studio, pulling in more than 350 million dollars worldwide across its theatrical runs.

News Overview

David Bruckner has signed on to direct Smile 3 for Paramount, with original creator Parker Finn transitioning to a producing role and Nick Antosca penning the script. The upcoming horror sequel builds on a highly successful franchise that has grossed over 350 million dollars worldwide.

news:1dt1418.k: Zhou Qunfei richest woman, Lens Technology founder Zhou Qunfei, Hurun Richest Women in China 2026, Zhong Huijuan Hansoh Pharmaceutical, Zhou Qunfei Hurun Richest Women in China 2026, Zhou Qunfei, Zhong Huijuan Hurun Richest Women in China 2026, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Reclaiming the Top Spot

Zhou Qunfei has once again secured her position as the wealthiest woman in China. According to the Hurun Richest Women in China 2026 list, her total fortune is estimated at 127 billion yuan, which translates to approximately ₹ 1.8 lakh crore.

Her net worth grew by 15 percent over the course of a single year. This growth allowed her to surpass Hansoh Pharmaceutical founder Zhong Huijuan, whose wealth stands at 124 billion yuan or around ₹ 1.76 lakh crore.

Humble Beginnings in Hunan and Shenzhen

Born in 1970 in China's Hunan province, Zhou left her schooling behind as a teenager to travel to Shenzhen in search of employment opportunities. Her initial steps into the workforce began at a watch-glass factory.

During her time at the facility, she earned a modest wage of around $1.20 a day. Despite the challenging circumstances, these early experiences laid the foundation for her future industrial career.

Building a Glass-Processing Enterprise

At the age of 23, Zhou made the decisive choice to venture out on her own by launching a glass-processing workshop. She dedicated herself to mastering complex technical skills, teaching herself advanced screen-printing and curved-glass manufacturing methods.

These self-taught techniques eventually formed the core capabilities of Lens Technology, the massive glass manufacturing giant she co-founded. The company grew rapidly to become a primary supplier of display glass for smartphones.

The Apple Partnership and Market Expansion

Lens Technology experienced a massive turning point after securing a deal to supply glass covers for Apple's very first iPhones in 2007. Official company prospectuses noted that Apple accounted for nearly half of the firm's main business revenue between 2011 and mid-2014.

A stock market listing in Shenzhen in March 2015 propelled Zhou to the number one spot on China's female wealth rankings for the first time. She had previously held the richest woman title that same year before market fluctuations altered the standings.

Navigating Economic Hurdles and Diversification

Zhou's financial standing encountered a significant obstacle in 2018 when trade tensions between the United States and China, alongside shifting Apple sales figures, caused a sharp drop in her company's share prices.

In response to these market pressures, Lens Technology successfully diversified its operations. The company expanded beyond smartphones into electric vehicles, artificial intelligence-related hardware, and robotics to capitalize on China's high-tech manufacturing sector.

Broader Trends in Chinese Wealth

Data compiled by Hurun indicates that a significant majority of China's top 50 wealthiest women are self-made entrepreneurs, with their combined assets reaching a record 1.93 trillion yuan.

When combined with her husband's assets, Zhou secured the 33rd position on China's overall Hurun Rich List. That broader list was led by ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming, whose fortune was evaluated at 670 billion yuan.

News Overview

Lens Technology founder Zhou Qunfei has reclaimed her position as China's richest woman with an estimated fortune of 127 billion yuan, surpassing Hansoh Pharmaceutical founder Zhong Huijuan. Rising from a teenage school dropout who earned $1.20 a day at a watch-glass factory, Zhou built her empire through self-taught manufacturing techniques and major supply contracts with Apple before diversifying into electric vehicles and AI hardware.

About Hurmat

Hurmat follows the journey of a bright and ambitious young woman trapped under strict family and societal restrictions. Raised in a highly conservative household, her choices are entirely controlled by her authoritarian father, who initially forbids her from pursuing higher education. When a supportive uncle steps in to help her enroll in a university, she moves to a modern city, catching a glimpse of a world beyond her boundaries and finding a new sense of independence. However, her life takes a darker, more complex turn as she falls for a classmate, throwing her into a turbulent storm of intense family conflicts, hidden secrets, betrayal, and high-stakes legal battles.

Episode Summary

Is episode mein Hurmat apne kaam aur university mein pareshan rehti hai kyunki uske abu ke guzar jane ke baad uska dil kisi kaam mein nahi lagta. Tabish usse milne aur baat karne ki koshish karta hai aur woh dono apni zindagi aur mushkilat ke bare mein baat karte hain. Tabish Hurmat ko yeh yakeen dilata hai ke woh uske sath hai aur unhe ye rishtha khatam nahi karna chahiye. Tabish ke ghar walon ke kehne par uski mangni ki baat chalti hai, aur Zafar sahab Tabish ko ek business assignment dete hain jisme Hurmat bhi shamil hoti hai. Office mein ek meeting ke dauran Tabish aur Hurmat ke darmiyan kuch baatein hoti hain. Dusri taraf, Hurmat ki ammi uske rishte aur tabiyat ko le kar pareshan hoti hain, woh chahti hain ke Hurmat Tabish se shadi kar le kyunki unhe lagta hai ke Hurmat ki bhalayi isi mein hai. Episode ke aakhir mein Hurmat aur ammi ke darmiyan is rishte aur shadi ke mauzu par baat hoti hai aur ammi Allah se dua karti hain ke Hurmat ke liye behtar faisla ho.

news:1e58gz0.k: Harleen Sethi, Divyenndu Sharma, Abhishek Banerjee, Pratik Gandhi, Amazon Prime Video, Harleen Sethi Mirzapur, Mirzapur, Divyenndu Sharma Mirzapur, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
New Addition to an Ambitious Project

Actor Harleen Sethi has officially come on board for an upcoming, highly anticipated streaming series commissioned by Amazon Prime Video. The project has already generated significant industry buzz for assembling a powerhouse cast of recognized performers from across the digital and cinematic landscape.

While specific character arcs and plot lines remain heavily guarded by the studio, insiders familiar with the development confirm that the production has already commenced principal photography. Sethi has reportedly stepped onto the sets and started filming her portions for the venture.

A High-Stakes Narrative Canvas

The forthcoming venture is being framed as an expansive, empire-style drama. Early production descriptions indicate that the storyline will delve deeply into intricate themes of authority, fierce ambition, and complex interpersonal connections.

Given the scope of an empire narrative, the project aims to leverage its grand scale to deliver a gripping viewing experience. The atmosphere is expected to be charged with intense power dynamics as the story unfolds across its episodes.

An Ensemble of Acclaimed Performers

Sethi shares screen space with a remarkable lineup of established talent. The series features Divyenndu Sharma and Abhishek Banerjee, both widely celebrated for their breakout work in the hit streaming franchise Mirzapur.

Also rounding out the primary cast is versatile actor Pratik Gandhi. Industry insiders note that bringing these distinct acting forces together creates a compelling on-screen synergy that elevates the project's overall pedigree.

Behind the Lens and Production Team

The direction of this ambitious undertaking rests in the hands of filmmaker Bhanu Pratap Singh. Known for his associations with prominent banners like Dharma Productions, Singh is at the helm of shaping the show's grand aesthetic and tonal vision.

Production is currently proceeding at a steady pace under Amazon Prime Video's banner. While cameras are rolling, creators have kept a tight lid on official promotional timelines and release dates.

Building on Recent Successes

Sethi boards this new venture following a wave of strong career momentum and positive critical reception for her recent performances. Her prior streaming credits include notable titles such as Broken But Beautiful, Kohrra, Doctors, Bad Cop, and The Gone Game.

Most recently, she drew praise for her gripping work in Netflix's thriller Shaque: Trust No One. Her addition to the Prime Video slate is seen as a natural continuation of her growing footprint in the digital space.

Busy Rosters for the Leading Men

The male leads of the series are similarly tied to high-profile undertakings. Divyenndu Sharma and Abhishek Banerjee have recently reunited for Mirzapur: The Movie, extending their successful journey within that cinematic universe.

Meanwhile, Pratik Gandhi balances a diverse portfolio spanning both films and web projects, with upcoming ventures that include Hansal Mehta’s Gandhi and Madgaon Express 2.

News Overview

Harleen Sethi has officially joined the cast of Amazon Prime Video's untitled empire-style drama directed by Bhanu Pratap Singh, with production already underway. She stars alongside a notable ensemble featuring Divyenndu Sharma, Abhishek Banerjee, and Pratik Gandhi, though character details and release dates remain unannounced.

ld.articleBody:
A Major Reunion on the Silver Screen

Bollywood is gearing up for a notable onscreen pairing as Bhumi Pednekar officially boards an upcoming comedy project. She is set to star alongside Akshay Kumar, marking their third joint venture in the film industry. The upcoming venture follows closely after their previous work together, bringing the two performers back to collaborate four years after they were last seen sharing cinematic space.

Industry circles have generated significant buzz regarding this casting choice, confirming that the lead actress has signed on to play a prominent role. Director Priyadarshan himself has validated these reports, establishing that the leading lady is locked in for the upcoming production.

A Milestone Project for Priyadarshan

This upcoming cinematic venture carries substantial historical weight for its director. The movie officially stands as Priyadarshan's ninety-ninth film at the helm of a directorial project. Over decades in the industry, the prolific filmmaker has built a massive body of work, making this upcoming release a notable entry in his career trajectory.

With production preparations underway, the creative team has structured a timeline that will take the project onto the floors toward the end of the year. The schedule points to filming beginning in the final week of November 2026.

Stepping Back into the 1970s

Narrative details indicate that the film will transport audiences several decades into the past. The story is reportedly anchored in the 1970s era, providing a distinct stylistic backdrop for the unfolding narrative. Within this period setting, Akshay Kumar is slated to portray a tiger hunter.

While specific plot points remain tightly under wraps, early indications suggest that the movie will balance comedic beats with its historical environment. Some initial discussions pointed toward potential themes involving wildlife conservation interwoven with the narrative's comedy and thriller elements, though the makers have kept a tight lid on an official detailed synopsis.

Continuing a Collaborative History

The upcoming comedy strengthens an established working relationship between the two lead performers. Their past ventures include prominent appearances in Toilet: Ek Prem Katha, which established their onscreen chemistry for audiences nationwide. They later reunited for Raksha Bandhan, which hit theaters in 2022 under the direction of Aanand L Rai.

This upcoming project promises to place the duo into an entirely different narrative context compared to their previous dramas and social comedies, shifting the atmosphere into a period-specific comedic landscape.

Production Logistics and Filming Locations

Behind the scenes, the film is backed by prominent producer Ramesh Taurani, who is steering the production through his banner. The filming schedule is projected to span approximately three months once principal photography kicks off.

Location scouts have targeted multiple regions for the shoot. Rajasthan and Mumbai have emerged as primary destinations for capturing the required period look and feel, while Bhopal is also under serious consideration as an additional shooting site.

Supporting Cast Speculation

Beyond the main leads, industry whispers point to additional veteran talent joining the ensemble. Reports have circulated suggesting that seasoned actors Annu Kapoor and Rajpal Yadav could potentially feature in supporting capacities.

As of now, official disclosures regarding their exact characters or the depth of their involvement in the narrative have not been formally released by the production team, leaving fans waiting for further casting announcements.

News Overview

Bhumi Pednekar is set to reunite with Akshay Kumar for director Priyadarshan's ninety-ninth film, a 1970s-set comedy where Kumar will play a tiger hunter. The project, produced by Ramesh Taurani, is scheduled to begin shooting in late November 2026 across locations including Mumbai, Rajasthan, and potentially Bhopal.

She is set to star alongside Akshay Kumar, marking their third joint venture in the film industry. The upcoming venture follows closely after their previous work together, bringing the two performers back to collaborate four years after they were last seen sharing cinematic space.

Industry circles have generated significant buzz regarding this casting choice, confirming that the lead actress has signed on to play a prominent role. Director Priyadarshan himself has validated these reports, establishing that the leading lady is locked in for the upcoming production.

This upcoming cinematic venture carries substantial historical weight for its director. The movie officially stands as Priyadarshan's ninety-ninth film at the helm of a directorial project. Over decades in the industry, the prolific filmmaker has built a massive body of work, making this upcoming release a notable entry in his career trajectory.

With production preparations underway, the creative team has structured a timeline that will take the project onto the floors toward the end of the year. The schedule points to filming beginning in the final week of November 2026.

Stepping Back into the 1970s

Narrative details indicate that the film will transport audiences several decades into the past. The story is reportedly anchored in the 1970s era, providing a distinct stylistic backdrop for the unfolding narrative. Within this period setting, Akshay Kumar is slated to portray a tiger hunter.

While specific plot points remain tightly under wraps, early indications suggest that the movie will balance comedic beats with its historical environment. Some initial discussions pointed toward potential themes involving wildlife conservation interwoven with the narrative's comedy and thriller elements, though the makers have kept a tight lid on an official detailed synopsis.

The upcoming comedy strengthens an established working relationship between the two lead performers. Their past ventures include prominent appearances in Toilet: Ek Prem Katha, which established their onscreen chemistry for audiences nationwide. They later reunited for Raksha Bandhan, which hit theaters in 2022 under the direction of Aanand L Rai.

This upcoming project promises to place the duo into an entirely different narrative context compared to their previous dramas and social comedies, shifting the atmosphere into a period-specific comedic landscape.

Behind the scenes, the film is backed by prominent producer Ramesh Taurani, who is steering the production through his banner. The filming schedule is projected to span approximately three months once principal photography kicks off.

Beyond the main leads, industry whispers point to additional veteran talent joining the ensemble. Reports have circulated suggesting that seasoned actors Annu Kapoor and Rajpal Yadav could potentially feature in supporting capacities.

ld.articleBody:
The Holiday Preview Unveiled

Pop artist Olivia Rodrigo is expanding her musical repertoire by stepping into seasonal music with her very first holiday track. To build excitement for the upcoming release, the singer shared a forty-second video preview on a Monday, showcasing a lighthearted and festive atmosphere.

The newly dropped teaser does not feature any audio or snippets of the actual song. Instead, it focuses heavily on a cheerful parlour game that sets a cozy, domestic mood for fans eagerly awaiting the drop.

A Star-Studded Guessing Game

The visual component of the teaser features recognizable guest stars playing a lively round of Heads Up. Saturday Night Live cast member Ben Marshall and Sex and the City actress Cynthia Nixon attempt to guess clues and figure out the identity on their headbands.

During the playful exchange, Marshall asks questions about whether the subject is an animal or a human, while Nixon wonders if she might be portraying a president. The group eventually confirms that the mystery subject belongs in the arts, prompting laughter from everyone involved.

Cozy Festive Aesthetics

The background of the video teaser reinforces the seasonal theme with warm, inviting home decor. Viewers can spot a roaring fireplace, holiday sweaters, and a glimpse of a decorated Christmas tree.

Adding to the traditional holiday atmosphere, Olivia Rodrigo's personal stocking is shown hanging carefully above the mantelpiece, tying the cozy living room setting together for the upcoming project.

Release Details and Schedule

Fans will not have to wait long to hear the complete track. 'Take Me Home (4 Christmas)' is scheduled to launch at 8 p.m. ET on Thursday, November 5.

The announcement of the video follows the earlier debut of the single's official artwork on Monday. That promotional image featured the singer sitting on the floor wearing a red Santa hat, matching lipstick, a candy cane-themed top, a black leather motorcycle jacket, and a polka dot skirt.

Recent Musical Context

This upcoming holiday single marks the very first piece of new music from Rodrigo since the summer. Her third studio album, you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love , made its debut back in June.

The full-length record has performed remarkably well since its launch, maintaining a strong presence on the charts and spending three consecutive weeks at the No. 1 spot on the Billboard 200.

News Overview

Olivia Rodrigo is preparing to drop her inaugural holiday song, 'Take Me Home (4 Christmas)', accompanied by a video teaser starring Cynthia Nixon and Ben Marshall. The single arrives following her recent successful studio album and is set for release on November 5.

ld.articleBody:
The Return of All's Fair

The popular legal drama series is officially making its comeback on Hulu this week for its second season. Despite receiving negative reviews during its initial run, the program managed to secure its place as the largest scripted premiere on the streaming platform within a three-year span.

The narrative follows the brilliant attorneys at the firm Grant, Ronson Greene as they navigate intense breakups, high-profile scandals, and intricate courtroom battles where wealth dictates the rules.

Season Two Plot and Conflicts

As the legal team steps back into the spotlight for the second installment, audiences can expect more dramatic secrets and high-stakes tension. Friendships will undergo severe stress while new alliances emerge among the staff.

A surprising revelation poses a direct threat to the survival of the firm itself, forcing the characters to adapt quickly to changing circumstances both inside and outside the courtroom.

Release Schedule and Streaming Details

Fans eager to watch the new episodes can tune in starting November 4th at midnight ET or 9 pm PT. The platform will drop the first three episodes simultaneously.

Following the initial premiere, subsequent episodes will become available on a weekly basis every Wednesday on Hulu as well as Disney+ for subscribers who have the bundle.

Returning Cast Members

The upcoming season brings back a large portion of the original ensemble to reprise their roles at the firm. Exactly seven core stars have been confirmed to return for the new episodes.

These familiar faces will continue to anchor the legal drama as the narrative delves deeper into their personal and professional lives.

New Series Regular and Guest Stars

In addition to the returning performers, the production has added a brand new series regular to the main lineup for the second season.

The ensemble is also expanding significantly with the introduction of seventeen new guest stars, which notably includes drag queens from RuPaul's Drag Race.

Background and Context

The legal drama established itself as a major viewing event on Hulu despite the critical reception it faced upon launch. The combination of high-fashion elements and legal maneuvering struck a chord with streaming audiences.

The show centers on a world where emotional bonds serve as battlegrounds and financial power rules every transaction.

News Overview

All's Fair is returning to Hulu for season two on November 4th with its first three episodes, following its success as the streamer's biggest scripted premiere in three years. The upcoming season features seven returning stars, one new series regular, and seventeen guest stars including RuPaul's Drag Race alumni.

ld.articleBody:
The Trial Reaches Deliberation Stage

Jurors at London's Southwark Crown Court have officially commenced their deliberations regarding the legal case involving British comedian and actor Russell Brand. Following a lengthy courtroom presentation of evidence and arguments that spanned three weeks, the panel of twelve individuals must now determine the final outcome of the proceedings.

The proceedings have drawn significant public and media attention, with the defendant maintaining a daily presence alongside his spouse throughout the court sessions. The conclusion of arguments marks a pivotal juncture in a high-profile judicial inquiry that has unfolded over multiple weeks.

Strict Instructions from the Bench

Judge Joel Bennathan delivered clear instructions to the jury panel before they retired to consider their decisions. The presiding judge emphasized that any conclusion reached by the court must represent the collective and absolute agreement of every single juror on the panel.

Highlighting the gravity of the deliberations, the bench noted that partial or split decisions are unacceptable under the legal parameters of the case. All twelve individuals must ultimately align on their findings for each specific count before an official verdict can be formally recorded.

Nature of the Charges and Accusations

The legal action stems from allegations brought forward by six different women who claim misconduct occurred between the years 1999 and 2009. Prosecutors presented arguments characterizing the defendant as a predatory individual during a decade when his career transitioned from stand-up comedy to mainstream prominence across the United Kingdom.

According to the prosecution's case, the alleged incidents took place across various locations including a hotel room, corporate office spaces, media facilities, and private residential properties. The defendant faces multiple formal allegations encompassing several counts of rape, sexual assault, and attempted indecent assault.

The Defense Position and Testimony

Entering formal pleas of not guilty to all charges against him, the 51-year-old entertainer took the stand to give evidence during the proceedings. While acknowledging a strong personal focus on romantic encounters during his earlier years, he maintained that all interactions were entirely consensual.

Legal representatives for the defense pointed out that the claimants delayed reporting the alleged incidents to law enforcement for many years. Furthermore, defense counsel argued that the credibility of the accusations was compromised following the broadcast of a media documentary that featured anonymous claims.

Closing Arguments and Legal Strategy

During his closing statement, defense lawyer Ian Winter asserted that the integrity of the legal process had been compromised by outside media influences. He urged the panel to strictly differentiate between unconventional personal behavior and actual criminal conduct under the law.

The defense emphasized to the jury that behaving rudely, disrespectfully, or leading an unconventional lifestyle does not constitute a criminal offense. Counsel argued that an active personal life, regardless of public perception or moral judgments, falls outside the scope of unlawful behavior.

Background and Career Context

The defendant first achieved widespread recognition in the early 2000s through provocative stand-up comedy routines, television hosting roles, and a prominent radio program. His career later expanded into international film appearances and notable high-profile personal relationships.

In more recent years, the performer shifted away from traditional entertainment mediums, relocating to the United States and developing a substantial digital following centered around personal wellness, commentary, and lifestyle topics.

News Overview

A twelve-person jury has begun deliberating in the trial of Russell Brand after receiving instructions from Judge Joel Bennathan that their decision must be unanimous. The comedian faces multiple counts of sexual misconduct involving six women, which he denies while his defense questions the timing and validity of the claims.

ld.articleBody:
Passing of a Culinary Icon

Chef Damu, widely recognised across Tamil households through his television work, passed away on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at the age of 72. He had reportedly been undergoing medical treatment at a private hospital in Chennai following a period of illness.

His death has prompted widespread tributes from members of the film industry, television audiences, and the broader culinary community.

Television and Film Career

Born Damodharan Kothandaraman, Chef Damu became a familiar television personality through programmes such as Arusuvai Neram and Vijay TV's popular reality cooking show Cooku With Comali, where serving as a judge introduced him to mainstream audiences.

In addition to his television work, he appeared in Tamil feature films, with credits including Kallappadam in 2015 and Ulkuthu in 2017.

Records and Honors

Chef Damu earned a doctorate in Hotel Management and Catering Technology from the University of Madras in 2004, reportedly becoming the first Indian chef to achieve a PhD in the field. He also secured a Guinness World Record in December 2010 for completing the longest individual cooking marathon by preparing 617 dishes over 24 hours.

In recognition of his contributions to the culinary arts, he was conferred India's prestigious Padma Shri civilian honor in 2025.

Renowned chef and television personality Damodharan Kothandaraman has passed away at the age of 72 in Chennai following a period of illness. He was widely known for his television shows, acting roles, a PhD in Hotel Management, a Guinness World Record, and the Padma Shri award he received in 2025.

ld.articleBody:
A Magical Ballroom Transformation

The popular competition series recently welcomed audiences back into the ballroom for a whimsical, Disney-inspired evening filled with Broadway-themed routines. Only eight remaining couples were left in the running, putting their best foot forward to impress both the panel of experts and the viewing public.

Contestants performed vibrant numbers inspired by legendary animated classics, beloved tales, and famous stage productions. The evening delivered plenty of memorable highlights, ranging from standout choreographies to energetic group performances.

Unusual Schedule Adjustment

This week's installment deviated from the show's customary broadcast routine by airing on a Monday night instead of the usual Tuesday slot. The network implemented this change to clear the schedule for upcoming live television coverage of the United States midterm elections.

Broadway Night Inspiration

The special themed installment drew direct inspiration from famous Broadway productions and timeless cinematic tales. Competitors delivered routines set to music from popular favorites like Peter Pan, Tangled, and Beauty and the Beast.

In addition to animated classics, the ballroom saw performances honoring celebrated stage productions including Aida and Hamilton, showcasing the versatility of the remaining celebrity contestants and their professional partners.

A Shocking Elimination

Despite a magical atmosphere, the evening concluded on a disheartening note for actress Julia Stiles and her professional partner Ezra Sosa. The pair faced an unexpected exit from the competition after landing at the bottom of the combined results.

Their departure caught many viewers by surprise, particularly because the duo had shown noticeable improvement following criticism from a guest judge during the previous week. Their individual routine earned a solid score, followed by additional points during the team dance.

Leaderboard Dominance

At the top of the leaderboard, Harry Shum Jr. and his professional partner Jenna Johnson continued their impressive streak of dominance. Following a flawless score during the previous week's special, the talented duo secured another perfect score from the judges.

They were joined at the pinnacle of the rankings by Jenna Dewan and Val Chmerkovskiy, who also earned a maximum score for their magical night performance, keeping the competition fierce among the frontrunners.

Final Standings

When individual and team dance scores were combined, the standings revealed a tight race among the remaining pairs. Harry Shum Jr. and Jenna Johnson claimed the top spot, tied with Jenna Dewan and Val Chmerkovskiy at the absolute summit.

Further down the list, competitors like Ezra Frech, Connor Wood, Amber Glenn, Tatyana Ali, and Maura Higgins found themselves positioned across the leaderboard, while Julia Stiles and Ezra Sosa ultimately faced their elimination from the season.

News Overview

Dancing With The Stars Season 35 held a special Monday night broadcast for its Broadway-themed Disney Night ahead of midterm election coverage. The episode concluded with the unexpected elimination of Julia Stiles and Ezra Sosa, while top pairs like Harry Shum Jr. and Jenna Johnson maintained their leaderboard dominance with perfect scores.

The ballroom transformed for a magical Broadway-themed evening, but the night concluded with a surprising exit for Julia Stiles and Ezra Sosa.

Published 3 November 2026

A Magical Ballroom Transformation

The popular competition series recently welcomed audiences back into the ballroom for a whimsical, Disney-inspired evening filled with Broadway-themed routines. Only eight remaining couples were left in the running, putting their best foot forward to impress both the panel of experts and the viewing public.

Contestants performed vibrant numbers inspired by legendary animated classics, beloved tales, and famous stage productions. The evening delivered plenty of memorable highlights, ranging from standout choreographies to energetic group performances.

Unusual Schedule Adjustment

This week's installment deviated from the show's customary broadcast routine by airing on a Monday night instead of the usual Tuesday slot. The network implemented this change to clear the schedule for upcoming live television coverage of the United States midterm elections.

Broadway Night Inspiration

The special themed installment drew direct inspiration from famous Broadway productions and timeless cinematic tales. Competitors delivered routines set to music from popular favorites like Peter Pan, Tangled, and Beauty and the Beast.

In addition to animated classics, the ballroom saw performances honoring celebrated stage productions including Aida and Hamilton, showcasing the versatility of the remaining celebrity contestants and their professional partners.

A Shocking Elimination

Despite a magical atmosphere, the evening concluded on a disheartening note for actress Julia Stiles and her professional partner Ezra Sosa. The pair faced an unexpected exit from the competition after landing at the bottom of the combined results.

Their departure caught many viewers by surprise, particularly because the duo had shown noticeable improvement following criticism from a guest judge during the previous week. Their individual routine earned a solid score, followed by additional points during the team dance.

Leaderboard Dominance

At the top of the leaderboard, Harry Shum Jr. and his professional partner Jenna Johnson continued their impressive streak of dominance. Following a flawless score during the previous week's special, the talented duo secured another perfect score from the judges.

They were joined at the pinnacle of the rankings by Jenna Dewan and Val Chmerkovskiy, who also earned a maximum score for their magical night performance, keeping the competition fierce among the frontrunners.

Final Standings

When individual and team dance scores were combined, the standings revealed a tight race among the remaining pairs. Harry Shum Jr. and Jenna Johnson claimed the top spot, tied with Jenna Dewan and Val Chmerkovskiy at the absolute summit.

Further down the list, competitors like Ezra Frech, Connor Wood, Amber Glenn, Tatyana Ali, and Maura Higgins found themselves positioned across the leaderboard, while Julia Stiles and Ezra Sosa ultimately faced their elimination from the season.

News Overview

Dancing With The Stars Season 35 held a special Monday night broadcast for its Broadway-themed Disney Night ahead of midterm election coverage. The episode concluded with the unexpected elimination of Julia Stiles and Ezra Sosa, while top pairs like Harry Shum Jr. and Jenna Johnson maintained their leaderboard dominance with perfect scores.

Key facts

  • Dancing With The Stars Season 35 aired its Week 8 episode on Monday, November 2, 2026.
  • Julia Stiles and Ezra Sosa were eliminated from the competition.
  • Harry Shum Jr. and Jenna Johnson scored a perfect 40/40 on Disney Night.
  • Jenna Dewan and Val Chmerkovskiy also scored a perfect 40/40.
  • Julia Stiles and Ezra Sosa scored 33 out of 40 for their individual routine and earned 36 points during the team dance, totaling 69 out of 80.

ld.articleBody:
A Historic Milestone

The cinematic landscape of Kollywood has witnessed a monumental achievement as Jailer 2 officially claims the title of the highest-grossing Tamil film of all time. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and starring superstar Rajinikanth, the action-packed sequel achieved this historic feat within a mere 11 days of its theatrical run. Surpassing previous benchmarks set by long-standing blockbusters, the movie has successfully crossed the unprecedented ₹700-crore threshold globally.

Box Office Momentum

Industry analysts note that the momentum for the Sun Pictures production shows no signs of slowing down. During its second weekend, the feature pulled in staggering numbers internationally and domestically, proving that audience enthusiasm remains at an all-time high. With strong daily grosses still rolling in, trade circles are already speculating about the possibility of the film inching closer to even loftier financial milestones.

Domestic Dominance

In the domestic market, the Rajinikanth vehicle recorded an impressive single-day net collection on its eleventh day, reflecting a robust surge in ticket sales. This latest haul propelled its cumulative domestic net earnings close to the coveted ₹400-crore milestone. Achieving this feat places the project in an elite tier of domestic performers alongside its own predecessor and Vijay's hit movie Leo.

International Reach

Beyond domestic borders, the international appeal of the franchise has proven to be a massive driving force. Overseas territories contributed significantly to the overall tally, accumulating tens of millions in foreign currency and pushing the worldwide gross well past the ₹710-crore mark. This balanced performance across local and global markets underscores the widespread popularity of the lead actor.

Dethroning Previous Records

The journey to the top involved eclipsing several massive titles that previously dominated the upper echelons of Tamil cinema history. Jailer 2 successfully overtook the eight-year-old lifetime record previously held by the science-fiction spectacle 2.0. Along the way, it also surpassed other heavy hitters including Leo, the first part of the franchise, and another recent tentpole release, Coolie.

Exclusive Cinematic Club

By crossing ₹700 crore worldwide, the movie has carved out a unique space in Indian cinema history. It stands proudly as the seventh South Indian film to breach this elite financial tier and marks the eighteenth Indian film overall to enter the exclusive club, further cementing the global footprint of regional language cinema.

Cast and Crew Details

The project marks a notable departure for Rajinikanth, who historically has been hesitant to sign on for sequels to his legendary blockbusters. Reprising his celebrated role as 'Tiger' Muthuvel Pandian, the veteran actor leads a sprawling ensemble cast that blends returning fan favorites with prominent fresh faces. Actors such as Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu, Mirnaa, and Rithvik return from the original installment.

Music and Cameos

Adding to the cinematic spectacle are high-profile additions and cameo appearances featuring esteemed names from across Indian cinema, including S. J. Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Vidya Balan, Anna Rajan, Jatin Sarna, Hrithik Roshan, Mohanlal, Shiva Rajkumar, and Jackie Shroff. The sonic landscape of the movie, crucial to its high-energy pacing, was crafted by composer Anirudh Ravichander.

News Overview

Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and starring Rajinikanth, Jailer 2 has become the highest-grossing Tamil film of all time within 11 days. The Sun Pictures production has surpassed ₹700 crore globally, overtaking previous records held by films like 2.0 and Leo.

ld.articleBody:
A Memorable Television Appearance

Bollywood star Ranbir Kapoor recently reflected on his personal life while appearing as a guest on Kaun Banega Crorepati 18. Hosted by the legendary Amitabh Bachchan, the platform gave the actor a chance to share behind-the-scenes details about his romantic proposal to his wife, Alia Bhatt.

The revelation offered fans an entertaining look into one of the most talked-about relationships in the Hindi film industry, blending romance with unexpected wildlife adventure.

Planning the Maasai Mara Getaway

The romantic gesture took place during a vacation the couple took to Maasai Mara in Kenya. Eager to create a lasting memory, Ranbir meticulously planned how he would ask the crucial question.

Knowing how much his partner values photographs, especially for sharing on social media platforms like Instagram, the actor ensured that the moment would be properly documented from afar.

Preplanning and Coordination

To pull off the surprise, Ranbir took advance measures by tipping their local guide and driver before setting out into the wilderness. He instructed them to halt the vehicle in the middle of the jungle.

He had brought a ring from home and intended to drop down on one knee while the guide and driver captured the sequence using a camera from a safe distance.

An Unexpected Wildlife Encounter

The romantic scenario, however, quickly took a dramatic and wild turn when nature intervened. As Ranbir prepared to present the ring, he noticed three lions roaming roughly 100 feet away from them.

Prompted by the host Amitabh Bachchan, who jokingly asked for photographic evidence of the bizarre situation, the actor detailed just how close the predators were during the pivotal moment.

The Lion and the Mouse Metaphor

Describing the tense yet comical atmosphere, Ranbir offered a witty metaphor regarding the power dynamic of the moment. He humorously referred to Alia as his fierce lioness while casting himself in the role of a timid mouse.

With the wild cats lingering nearby, he dropped to one knee and asked the question, calling the entire episode an extraordinary event that remains vividly etched in his memory.

Milestones in Their Relationship

Following their adventurous engagement, Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt officially tied the knot on April 14, 2022. The intimate wedding ceremony took place at their Mumbai home, surrounded by family members and close friends.

Later that same year, on November 6, 2022, the couple welcomed their daughter, Raha, marking another major milestone in their family life.

News Overview

Ranbir Kapoor shared an amusing story on Kaun Banega Crorepati 18 about proposing to Alia Bhatt in Maasai Mara with three lions nearby. The couple later married in April 2022 and welcomed their daughter Raha in November of that year.

ld.articleBody:
The Search For A New Caped Crusader

Four years after the establishment of DC Studios, co-chief James Gunn has provided fans with an encouraging update on the search for the DCU Batman. During a recent appearance on an official podcast alongside Jennifer Holland, Gunn addressed the long-standing speculation surrounding the iconic role and confirmed that the casting process is drawing closer.

While rumors frequently circulate regarding potential cameo appearances in upcoming projects, Gunn firmly dismissed these claims as untrue. He emphasized that the official search has not concluded yet and assured audiences that an announcement regarding the actor stepping into the cowl will happen in the near future.

Prioritizing Acting Talent Over Star Power

Discussing the criteria for the role, Gunn highlighted a distinct shift in how the character will be cast compared to historical precedents. He expressed excitement about prioritizing pure acting ability above traditional movie star status.

Drawing a parallel to how Superman is cast, Gunn noted that past cinematic interpretations of the Dark Knight have often relied heavily on established box office pull. For the upcoming DCU iteration, the creative team is focused entirely on finding the most capable performer for the part.

Aligning Ages With David Corenswet's Superman

Addressing persistent fan theories about the character's age, Gunn clarified that the new Batman will be a contemporary of David Corenswet's Superman. The two heroes will share a relatively similar age bracket rather than having a vast generational gap.

This dynamic sets the stage for the classic partnership between the two heroes. Gunn described them as future best pals and contemporaries within the overarching narrative structure of the shared universe.

Early Teases And Creative Leadership

Audiences were given a very brief glimpse into the potential aesthetic and tone of this new Dark Knight during a recent penultimate episode of Creature Commandos titled Priyatel Skelet. This subtle tease offered a minor preview of what to expect from the character moving forward.

Behind the camera, Andy Muschietti remains attached to direct the standalone feature. Muschietti previously directed The Flash and is now tasked with bringing this new iteration to the big screen.

Adapting The Brave And The Bold

The upcoming film introducing the DCU version of the hero is officially titled The Brave and the Bold. The project will draw heavy creative inspiration from the acclaimed comic book run written by Grant Morrison.

In addition to introducing the new Gotham protector, the feature will incorporate elements of the wider Bat-family into the cinematic narrative. This approach distinguishes the DCU project from separate iterations, such as the Matt Reeves films starring Robert Pattinson.

News Overview

James Gunn stated that the casting process for the DCU Batman is approaching soon and that the character will be a contemporary of David Corenswet's Superman. Andy Muschietti is attached to direct The Brave and the Bold, which draws from Grant Morrison's comics and will remain separate from Robert Pattinson's films.

news:1fsijq5.d: Julia Stiles and partner Ezra Sosa faced elimination on the Nov. 2 Disney Night episode of Dancing With the Stars following a Paso Doble routine.
news:1fsijq5.k: Julia Stiles Dancing With the Stars, Disney Night Dancing With the Stars, Ezra Sosa Julia Stiles elimination, Dancing With the Stars Nov 2, Dancing With the Stars, Julia Stiles, Ezra Sosa Dancing With the Stars, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Disney Night Elimination

The latest episode of Dancing With the Stars brought a magical atmosphere to the ballroom for Disney Night on Nov. 2, but it also marked the end of the journey for actress Julia Stiles and her professional dance partner Ezra Sosa. Despite delivering a Paso Doble routine to the track Satisfied from the musical Hamilton, the pair were sent home.

Reflecting on her departure after the episode, Stiles expressed that the journey had brought out unexpected strength within her and noted she would miss working alongside Sosa daily.

Reflections From the Partnership

Ezra Sosa shared similar sentiments regarding their time together on the program, praising the Save the Last Dance star for the noticeable progress she displayed both inside and outside of the ballroom environment.

Sosa expressed gratitude for the opportunity to share the television experience with Stiles, highlighting her personal growth throughout the competition.

Standout Performances of the Night

While one couple exited the competition, several other participants earned top scores during the themed evening. Harry Shum Jr. and Jenna Johnson secured a perfect score for their jazz routine set to Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious from Mary Poppins.

Jenna Dewan and Val Chmerkovskiy also matched the achievement, earning top marks for a quickstep performance to Be Our Guest from Beauty and the Beast.

Broadway and Additional Routines

Other notable numbers included Amber Glenn and Pasha Pashkov performing a quickstep to A Star Is Born from Hercules, while Ezra Frech and Daniella Karagach danced a samba to Under the Sea from The Little Mermaid.

Additionally, Tatyana Ali and Jan Ravnik brought a Broadway flair to the floor with a contemporary routine inspired by Easy as Life from the musical Aida.

Context From Prior Weeks

The festive Disney-themed instalment stood in contrast to Horror Movie Night during the previous week, which saw a double elimination involving baseball player Jackson Olson with Emma Slater, and reality television personality Tyler Cameron with Sharna Burgess.

Following that earlier exit, Burgess praised Cameron for his maturity and noted the strong friendship they built away from the dance floor.

News Overview

Julia Stiles and her professional partner Ezra Sosa were eliminated from Dancing With the Stars during the Nov. 2 Disney Night episode after performing a Paso Doble to music from Hamilton. The evening featured high-scoring routines from other pairs such as Harry Shum Jr. and Jenna Dewan, following a previous week's double elimination that removed Jackson Olson and Tyler Cameron from the competition.
