news:zpd33r.k: Bigg Boss 20 Weekend Ka Vaar, Salman Khan ScoutOP Love Gill, Kaashvi Hiranandani Bigg Boss, Bigg Boss 20 Oct 31 2026, Salman Khan Bigg Boss 20, Bigg Boss 20, Salman Khan, ScoutOP Bigg Boss 20, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Return Of The Host And High Tensions

The latest Weekend Ka Vaar episode of Bigg Boss 20 brought host Salman Khan back to the television screen following a one-week break. Anticipation among viewers had been high all week, particularly because ScoutOP's girlfriend, Kaashvi Hiranandani, had made an appearance on the previous week's episode. When the host finally stepped onto the stage, the atmosphere inside the house was charged with high tension as several controversies from the past few days waited to be addressed.

Salman immediately took charge of the situation, focusing heavily on relationship dynamics and personal accountability. He delivered relationship advice to the housemates, stating that if any partner wishes to walk away from a relationship, they should be permitted to leave. Furthermore, he emphasized that no third party holds the power to break a bond, sharing his own perspective on how he would have handled similar circumstances maturely while firmly supporting his friendships.

Confrontation With ScoutOP

The spotlight quickly turned toward ScoutOP, whom Salman confronted directly regarding his behavior and lack of support for Love Gill. The superstar stated that the gamer had proved loyalty meant nothing to him over the past week. Salman pointed out that Scout failed to defend the person he called a sister in front of his girlfriend, did not answer her questions, and neglected to stand beside her when she needed support.

When Scout attempted to defend his actions, Salman interrupted him, noting that he had even nominated his sisterly figure with a strange reason. The host also questioned Scout's nervous demeanor during Kaashvi's previous visit, asking why he did not appear happy. Scout tried to explain that he had felt panicked and mentioned that Rohit sir had spoken, but the explanation did little to appease the host.

Addressing Kaashvi Hiranandani's Remark

Salman shifted his focus to the controversial remark made by Kaashvi Hiranandani against Love Gill. Expressing clear support for Love, the superstar criticized Kaashvi's comments and questioned whether Scout was simply a gullible child easily manipulated by outside forces. He reminded the gamer that the person targeted was someone he called his sister.

Additionally, Salman asked Scout to be honest about his feelings and questioned if his primary goal was merely saving his relationship with Kaashvi. He informed the housemates that the internet personality had since apologized for her remarks about Love. However, the host also turned his attention to Love, questioning why she compromised her self-respect while patching things up and failing to stand up for herself initially.

Love Gill Speaks Out

Given the opportunity to speak, Love Gill directly addressed Kaashvi Hiranandani's remarks. The Punjabi actress stated that Kaashvi should not have spoken about her since they did not share any personal bond.

Love argued that the entire matter strictly concerned Scout and his girlfriend, asserting that dragging her into the dispute was entirely unwarranted.

Reality Checks For Other Housemates

The Weekend Ka Vaar episode did not stop at Scout and Love, as several other contestants also received reality checks from the host. Salman called out Amrapali Dubey, informing her that the other housemates were taking her for granted because of her own submissive behavior in treating herself as someone who deserved such treatment.

The host also addressed a physical altercation that had occurred between Gullu and Yung. He slammed Gullu for getting involved in yet another violent clash inside the house, advising him that such incidents were unacceptable. Meanwhile, Mahi Vij received criticism regarding her gameplay, with Salman pointing out that her overall performance in the house had fallen short of expectations.

News Overview

Salman Khan returned to host the Bigg Boss 20 Weekend Ka Vaar episode on October 31, 2026, where he confronted ScoutOP over his lack of loyalty toward Love Gill. He also slammed Kaashvi Hiranandani's remarks against Love and gave reality checks to contestants including Amrapali Dubey, Gullu, Yung, and Mahhi Vij.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction To Episode 5

The romantic comedy K-drama Love In Disguise continues to capture attention with its chaotic charm and brilliant lead chemistry. Available for streaming on Prime Video, the series features Yim Si-wan and Seol In-ah as dynamic workplace partners.

Following the wild events of the previous week, Episode 5 amps up the tension in the CEO and bodyguard or personal assistant relationship. Viewers are treated to an escalation of comedic misunderstandings and high stakes.

Source Material And Background

The television series is adapted from the popular web novel Why You Don't Know It's a Girl? by author Lee A Yeon. This source material sets up the core identity confusion that drives much of the narrative comedy.

The story thrives on mistaken identity, blending workplace romance tropes with quirky situations. The dynamic between the main characters remains a primary draw for audiences worldwide.

The Aftermath Of The Garden Kiss

Episode 5 kicks off directly following the drunken garden kiss shared between Jae Hui and Yi Jun. While Jae Hui manages to get a peaceful sleep, Yi Jun spends the night tossing and turning.

Yi Jun is left in a state of confusion because he believes he shared a romantic moment with a man. This internal turmoil forms the basis for much of the episode's comedic relief.

Complications With Lee Si A

The plot thickens with the introduction of Lee Si A, who serves as Yi Jun's fiancée and childhood friend. Unaware that Jae Hui is actually a woman, Si A surprisingly finds herself developing a crush on her.

During conversations about office romances and boss-secretary affairs, Si A inadvertently keeps Jae Hui on Yi Jun's mind. This creates a multi-layered web of hilarious romantic confusion.

The Climax And Sober Kiss

Amid an ongoing murder investigation and typical workplace chaos, the episode approaches its climax when Yi Jun spots Jae Hui talking to Da-un. Driven by jealousy, Yi Jun confronts her directly.

In a surprising final scene, Yi Jun delivers a sober kiss to confirm his feelings, leaving Jae Hui with wide-eyed shock. This unexpected gesture triggers flashbacks, causing Jae Hui to finally remember their previous drunken kiss.

Preview And Spoilers For Episode 6

The preview for Episode 6 hints at further complications, particularly with Lee Si A growing increasingly obsessed with Jae Hui. Meanwhile, pressure mounts as Yi Jun's father demands a marriage announcement before the shareholder meeting.

New dramatic tensions emerge as misunderstandings grow between the leads. Yi Jun is seen snapping at Jae Hui, and a final preview clip shows Jae Hui expressing profound disappointment in someone she thought was a good human being.

News Overview

Episode 5 of Love In Disguise on Prime Video delivers a shocking climax featuring a sober kiss and the return of Jae Hui's memories regarding their earlier drunken encounter. As Yim Si-wan and Seol In-ah navigate escalating romantic tensions and misunderstandings, upcoming episodes promise further drama involving Yi Jun's fiancée and impending family pressures.

ld.articleBody:
Expanding the Live Itinerary

The internationally recognized music ensemble has officially extended their ongoing concert series, adding eleven brand-new performance dates spanning across Asia, Australia, and New Zealand. This upcoming leg of the schedule is set to kick off in early 2027, giving loyal supporters in these regions an opportunity to experience the group live on stage.

Promoted by Live Nation, the newly announced leg begins on January 27 at the Yokohama Arena in Japan. From there, the routing travels through major metropolitan areas before concluding its run on March 5 at Spark Arena.

Tour Stops and Schedule Details

Following the opening performance in Japan, the itinerary includes stops in Manila, Hong Kong, Seoul, Cebu, Singapore, Bangkok, and Taipei. After taking a scheduled ten-day break, the performers will head down under for concerts in Sydney and Melbourne.

The general ticket sales for these newly added international performances are scheduled to open up to the public on Friday, November 6 at local times through the official group web portal.

Returning to Friendly Territories

This upcoming journey marks a swift return for the musicians, who previously visited the region earlier in the year for promotional activities, fan question-and-answer sessions, and industry showcases.

Members previously expressed a strong fondness for their time abroad, with bandmate Lara Raj sharing with media networks that the group deeply enjoyed their stay and would happily spend extended periods performing there again.

Lineup Questions and Member Hiatus

While the schedule is firmly set, questions remain regarding the exact roster of performers who will take the stage for these international dates, specifically concerning member Sophia Laforteza.

The management label previously initiated a temporary leave for Laforteza to prioritize her personal wellness and mental health. However, recent announcements from the label indicate a planned return to live performances in January, aligning well with the start of the Asia routing.

Recent Milestones and Album Success

The group has been busy establishing major chart achievements, currently navigating their first-ever arena tour across North America. These concurrent dates celebrate their recent musical releases, including a successful album that claimed the top spot on major charts earlier in the year.

International Girl Group KATseye Announces Expanded Tour Dates Across Asia and Australia

The acclaimed pop act has added eleven fresh concert dates to their schedule, bringing their extensive live performances to multiple new regions early next year.

Published 29 October 2026

Expanding the Live Itinerary

The internationally recognized music ensemble has officially extended their ongoing concert series, adding eleven brand-new performance dates spanning across Asia, Australia, and New Zealand. This upcoming leg of the schedule is set to kick off in early 2027, giving loyal supporters in these regions an opportunity to experience the group live on stage.

Promoted by Live Nation, the newly announced leg begins on January 27 at the Yokohama Arena in Japan. From there, the routing travels through major metropolitan areas before concluding its run on March 5 at Spark Arena.

Tour Stops and Schedule Details

Following the opening performance in Japan, the itinerary includes stops in Manila, Hong Kong, Seoul, Cebu, Singapore, Bangkok, and Taipei. After taking a scheduled ten-day break, the performers will head down under for concerts in Sydney and Melbourne.

The general ticket sales for these newly added international performances are scheduled to open up to the public on Friday, November 6 at local times through the official group web portal.

Returning to Friendly Territories

This upcoming journey marks a swift return for the musicians, who previously visited the region earlier in the year for promotional activities, fan question-and-answer sessions, and industry showcases.

Members previously expressed a strong fondness for their time abroad, with bandmate Lara Raj sharing with media networks that the group deeply enjoyed their stay and would happily spend extended periods performing there again.

Lineup Questions and Member Hiatus

While the schedule is firmly set, questions remain regarding the exact roster of performers who will take the stage for these international dates, specifically concerning member Sophia Laforteza.

The management label previously initiated a temporary leave for Laforteza to prioritize her personal wellness and mental health. However, recent announcements from the label indicate a planned return to live performances in January, aligning well with the start of the Asia routing.

Recent Milestones and Album Success

The group has been busy establishing major chart achievements, currently navigating their first-ever arena tour across North America. These concurrent dates celebrate their recent musical releases, including a successful album that claimed the top spot on major charts earlier in the year.

This recent musical milestone follows a previous release that also performed remarkably well on survey charts, further cementing the ensemble's growing global presence and commercial appeal.

Documentary Release and Media Presence

Alongside their live music endeavors, supporters can also explore a recently launched documentary feature that chronicles the group's journey. The project is currently accessible for digital viewing across streaming platforms in domestic and international regions.

The ensemble also recently made a high-profile appearance at a major fashion event, where several members shared updates regarding future touring plans and member returns.

  • The Wildworld Tour expands with 11 new shows across Asia, Australia, and New Zealand.
  • The new leg starts on January 27 at Yokohama Arena in Yokohama, Japan.
  • The tour concludes on March 5 at Auckland's Spark Arena.
  • The general onsale for the concerts begins Friday, November 6 at 2pm local time.
  • Lara Raj, Megan Skiendiel, Yoonchae Jeong, and Daniela Avanzini performed at the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show 2026.
  • Sophia Laforteza went on a temporary hiatus in April for mental health and wellness.
  • The album WILD reached No. 1 on the Billboard 200 in August.
